literature.headline_zh: 登革病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期登革病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 在 120 名患者中,35% 的患者患有登革热但没有警告信号,48.3% 的患者有警告信号,16.7% 的患者患有 重症登革热。随着疾病严重程度的增加,MPV 和 PCT 下降,而 PDW 显着增加(P < 0.001)。肝功能障碍 (31.7%) 和肾功能障碍 (9.2%) 与较低的 MPV 和 PCT 以及较高的 PDW 相关(P < 0.001)。PDW 与严重程度呈强正相关 (r = 0.71),而 MPV 和 PCT 呈负相关。 [10.4103/aam.aam_591_26]
用丙氨酸或甘氨酸取代 L162 会破坏 ZSWIM8-CUL3 E3 泛素连接酶的 NS5 募集,从而保持 STAT2 稳定性并恢复 IFN 信号传导。携带这些 突变 的重组 ZIKV 在人类细胞中表现出复制减少和 ISG 诱导增强,并且通过 STAT2 敲除完全挽救了缺陷。 [10.1073/pnas.2630605123]

该研究发现登革热和 COVID-19 监测 记录之间存在皮尔逊反相关性(r = -0.331,bootstrap 95% CI -0.349 至 -0.312;Spearman rho = -0.311),但这种关联的方向和幅度因年份而异,从 2021 年的 r = 0.096 到 2023 年的 r = -0.312。人口标准化得出 r = -0.386,而消除州和日历周效应则将关联性降低至 r = -0.049。 [10.1186/s12982-026-02929-4]
DH1017.IgM 和 C8.IgM 均以剂量依赖性方式持续降低一组 ZIKV 结合 IgG mAb 中 IgG 介导的 ADE,其中 DH1017.IgM 经证实可在 ZIKV 感染个体血清中的亚中和浓度下抑制 ADE。 [10.1016/j.isci.2026.117897]
长滞后干燥、中滞后温暖和短滞后潮湿条件与五个气候区的最高相对风险相关,温带地区的温度异常比热带地区对水文气象动态的影响更大。 [10.64898/2026.10.16.26365716]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Since 2024, another 7.4 million cases and over 5000 deaths have been reported globally, with the Americas being the most impacted region. [10.1111/joim.70174]

Among 120 patients, 35% had dengue without warning signs, 48.3% had warning signs, and 16.7% had severe dengue. MPV and PCT decreased, while PDW increased significantly with disease severity (P < 0.001). Hepatic (31.7%) and renal (9.2%) dysfunction were associated with lower MPV and PCT and higher PDW (P < 0.001). [10.4103/aam.aam_591_26]
Substitution of L162 with alanine or glycine disrupted NS5 recruitment of the ZSWIM8-CUL3 E3 ubiquitin ligase, preserving STAT2 stability and restoring IFN signaling. [10.1073/pnas.2630605123]

The study found an inverse Pearson correlation (r = -0.331, bootstrap 95% CI -0.349 to -0.312; Spearman rho = -0.311) between dengue and COVID-19 surveillance records, but the direction and magnitude of this association varied by year, from r = 0.096 in 2021 to r = -0.312 in 2023. [10.1186/s12982-026-02929-4]

Both DH1017.IgM and C8.IgM consistently reduced IgG-mediated ADE across a panel of ZIKV-binding IgG mAbs in a dose-dependent manner, with DH1017.IgM confirmed to inhibit ADE at sub-neutralizing concentrations in sera of ZIKV-infected individuals. [10.1016/j.isci.2026.117897]

brief_items_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
Since 2024, another 7.4 million cases and over 5000 deaths have been reported globally, with the Americas being the most impacted region. [10.1111/joim.70174].

Among 120 patients, 35% had dengue without warning signs, 48.3% had warning signs, and 16.7% had severe dengue. MPV and PCT decreased, while PDW increased significantly with disease severity (P < 0.001).

papers.title: Regional and Temporal Dynamics of Dengue in Mexico (2020-2024): A Comprehensive Epidemiological Analysis.
papers.abstract: Dengue remains a major public health concern in Mexico, with incidence and clinical burden increasing substantially in recent years. Using national surveillance data from 2020 to 2024, this study provides a comprehensive overview of the changing epidemiological landscape, with an emphasis on geographic distribution, temporal trends, serotype dynamics, and disease severity. Over this period, Mexico saw an almost fivefold increase in dengue cases, reaching over 123,000 confirmed infections and 426 deaths in 2024, the highest annual number recorded. Seasonal patterns shifted, with sustained transmission extending into unusual winter months from late 2023. Serotyping data revealed a shift in predominant virus serotypes, with DENV2 predominating until 2022, DENV1 peaking in 2021, and DENV3 rising sharply from 2022 onward, becoming dominant in 2023 and almost exclusive by 2024. This shift coincided with a sustained rise in dengue with warning signs (from 16.9% in 2020 to > 42% in 2023-2024) and higher hospitalisation rates, while severe dengue remained below 5%. Although DENV3 dominated nationally, DENV1 and DENV2 persisted in specific states, and DENV4 circulated sporadically, particularly in southern and northern regions. Several traditionally low-prevalence states experienced atypical outbreaks, underscoring the potential for sudden epidemic expansion. Climatic analysis showed a consistent positive association between temperature and DENV3 prevalence, with precipitation effects varying by year. Odds ratio analysis suggested serotype-specific differences in severity across years. These findings underscore the heterogeneous and dynamic nature of dengue transmission in Mexico and highlight the need for regional surveillance, prevention, and clinical preparedness strategies.

analysis.scope_and_question: This review focuses on the regional and temporal dynamics of dengue in Mexico from 2020 to 2024, examining geographic distribution, temporal trends, serotype dynamics, and disease severity. The central question is to understand how dengue transmission patterns have evolved over this period and their implications for public health.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review utilizes national surveillance data from 2020 to 2024. It includes a comprehensive analysis of serotype-specific data, climatic factors, and hospitalization rates. The study design is based on observational epidemiological data, with no explicit mention of meta-analysis or consensus processes.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that dengue incidence and clinical burden have increased substantially in Mexico, with DENV3 becoming dominant by 2024. It also notes that severe dengue remained below 5% of cases, while warning signs increased significantly. The findings highlight the dynamic and heterogeneous nature of dengue transmission across different regions and years.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review identifies a shift in predominant serotypes over time, with DENV3 rising sharply from 2022 onward. However, the exact mechanisms driving this shift are not fully explained. Additionally, the study notes that several traditionally low-prevalence states experienced atypical outbreaks, but the reasons for these variations are not clearly addressed.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review emphasizes the need for regional surveillance, prevention, and clinical preparedness strategies due to the changing epidemiological landscape. It also suggests that further research is required to understand the factors contributing to the shift in serotype dominance and the reasons behind the atypical outbreaks in certain states.

analysis.summary_en: This review provides an in-depth analysis of the regional and temporal dynamics of dengue in Mexico from 2020 to 2024. It highlights a significant increase in dengue cases, with DENV3 becoming dominant by 2024. The study also notes a rise in warning signs and hospitalization rates, while severe dengue remained relatively low. The findings underscore the need for targeted surveillance and preparedness strategies, as well as further research to understand the underlying factors driving these changes.

elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 审查得出的结论是,墨西哥的登革热 重症登革热 和临床负担大幅增加,到 2024 年 DENV3 将成为主导。审查还指出,重症登革热 病例的比例仍低于 5%,而警告信号显着增加。研究结果强调了登革热 传播 在不同地区和年份的动态和异质性。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 审查发现,随着时间的推移,主要血清型发生了变化,从 2022 年起,DENV3 急剧上升。然而,驱动这种转变的确切机制尚未得到充分解释。此外,研究指出,一些传统上低 患病率 的状态经历了非典型的 暴发,但这些变化的原因尚未明确说明。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述强调,由于流行病学形势的变化,需要制定区域 监测、预防和临床准备策略。它还表明需要进一步的研究来了解导致血清型优势转变的因素以及某些州非典型 暴发 背后的原因。

analysis_en.scope_and_question: This review focuses on the regional and temporal dynamics of dengue in Mexico from 2020 to 2024, examining geographic distribution, temporal trends, serotype dynamics, and disease severity. The central question is to understand how dengue transmission patterns have evolved over this period and their implications for public health.
analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review utilizes national surveillance data from 2020 to 2024. It includes a comprehensive analysis of serotype-specific data, climatic factors, and hospitalization rates. The study design is based on observational epidemiological data, with no explicit mention of meta-analysis or consensus processes.
analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that dengue incidence and clinical burden have increased substantially in Mexico, with DENV3 becoming dominant by 2024. It also notes that severe dengue remained below 5% of cases, while warning signs increased significantly. The findings highlight the dynamic and heterogeneous nature of dengue transmission across different regions and years.
analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review identifies a shift in predominant serotypes over time, with DENV3 rising sharply from 2022 onward. However, the exact mechanisms driving this shift are not fully explained. Additionally, the study notes that several traditionally low-prevalence states experienced atypical outbreaks, but the reasons for these variations are not clearly addressed.
analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: The review emphasizes the need for regional surveillance, prevention, and clinical preparedness strategies due to the changing epidemiological landscape. It also suggests that further research is required to understand the factors contributing to the shift in serotype dominance and the reasons behind the atypical outbreaks in certain states.

papers.title_zh: 墨西哥2020-2024年登革热的区域与时间动态:一项全面的流行病学分析。
papers.source_body_en: Dengue remains a major public health concern in Mexico, with incidence and clinical burden increasing substantially in recent years. Using national surveillance data from 2020 to 2024, this study provides a comprehensive overview of the changing epidemiological landscape, with an emphasis on geographic distribution, temporal trends, serotype dynamics, and disease severity. Over this period, Mexico saw an almost fivefold increase in dengue cases, reaching over 123,000 confirmed infections and 426 deaths in 2024, the highest annual number recorded. Seasonal patterns shifted, with sustained transmission extending into unusual winter months from late 2023. Serotyping data revealed a shift in predominant virus serotypes, with DENV2 predominating until 2022, DENV1 peaking in 2021, and DENV3 rising sharply from 2022 onward, becoming dominant in 2023 and almost exclusive by 2024. This shift coincided with a sustained rise in dengue with warning signs (from 16.9% in 2020 to > 42% in 2023-2024) and higher hospitalisation rates, while severe dengue remained below 5%. Although DENV3 dominated nationally, DENV1 and DENV2 persisted in specific states, and DENV4 circulated sporadically, particularly in southern and northern regions. Several traditionally low-prevalence states experienced atypical outbreaks, underscoring the potential for sudden epidemic expansion. Climatic analysis showed a consistent positive association between temperature and DENV3 prevalence, with precipitation effects varying by year. Odds ratio analysis suggested serotype-specific differences in severity across years. These findings underscore the heterogeneous and dynamic nature of dengue transmission in Mexico and highlight the need for regional surveillance, prevention, and clinical preparedness strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 登革热仍然是墨西哥的主要公共卫生问题,近年来其流行程度和临床负担显著增加。本研究利用2020年至2024年的全国登革热数据,全面概述了登革热流行病学景观的变化,重点分析了地理分布、时间趋势、血清型动态以及疾病严重程度。在这一时期,墨西哥的登革热病例数几乎增加了五倍,2024年达到超过123,000例确诊病例和426例死亡,这是有记录以来最高的年度病例数。季节性模式发生了变化,持续的登革热传播从2023年底延伸到了不寻常的冬季月份。血清型数据揭示了主要病毒血清型的变化,DENV2在2022年之前占主导地位,DENV1在2021年达到高峰,而DENV3则从2022年开始急剧上升,成为2023年的主导血清型,并在2024年几乎成为唯一流行的血清型。这种变化与登革热病例数的持续上升以及警告信号的增加(从2020年的16.9%上升到2023-2024年的>42%)相吻合,同时医院入院率也显著提高,而重症登革热病例仍低于5%。尽管DENV3在全国范围内占主导地位,但DENV1和DENV2在某些州仍持续存在,而DENV4则在南部和北部地区偶有流行。一些传统上登革热流行率较低的州出现了非典型的流行模式,突显了登革热暴发可能突然扩展的潜在风险。气候分析显示,温度与DENV3的流行率之间存在一致的正相关关系,而降水的影响则因年份而异。比值比分析表明,不同血清型在不同年份的严重程度存在差异。这些发现突显了墨西哥登革热传播模式的异质性和动态性,并强调了制定区域性监测、预防和临床准备策略的必要性。

papers.title: Interacting climatic, environmental, biologic and socio-economic drivers of the global dengue expansion.
papers.abstract: Abstract Dengue is the most rapidly expanding mosquito‐borne viral disease worldwide. The worst year on record was 2024, with over 100 countries reporting 14.4 million cases and over 11,000 deaths. Since then, and up to August 2026, another 7.4 million cases and over 5000 deaths have been reported. The region of the Americas was impacted the most, followed by South‐East Asia and the Western Pacific. Both the spread of dengue viruses (DENV) and their primary vectors, Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus , are driven by several factors. Globalization has accelerated vector dispersal, particularly through international trade and transportation networks. The movement of desiccation‐resistant eggs in used‐vehicle tyres and the inadvertent transport of adult mosquitoes via trucks and passenger vehicles have enabled the establishment of vector populations in previously uncolonized regions. Human mobility and unplanned urbanization further contribute to dengue emergence by introducing DENV into susceptible populations where competent vectors circulate. Climate change has enhanced dengue transmission potential by altering temperature and rainfall patterns that influence mosquito survival, reproduction, biting behaviour and viral replication. Containing or even reversing this global dengue expansion will require a complementary set of interventions that rely on proven and novel control strategies, including sterile insect techniques, Wolbachia‐ infected mosquitoes, virus‐resistant mosquito strains through CRISPR‐Cas9 gene drive, vaccines, antiviral drug prophylaxis and urban interventions that eliminate Aedes habitats. Building climate‐resilient urban environments through sustainable development to minimize the urban heat island effect and advancing climate‐informed early warning systems are long‐term strategies for effective dengue control.

Since then, and up to August 2026, another 7.4 million cases and over 5000 deaths have been reported. The region of the Americas was impacted the most, followed by South‐East Asia and the Western Pacific. Both the spread of dengue viruses (DENV) and their primary vectors, Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus , are driven by several factors. Globalization has accelerated vector dispersal, particularly through international trade and transportation networks. The movement of desiccation‐resistant eggs in used‐vehicle tyres and the inadvertent transport of adult mosquitoes via trucks and passenger vehicles have enabled the establishment of vector populations in previously uncolonized regions. Human mobility and unplanned urbanization further contribute to dengue emergence by introducing DENV into susceptible populations where competent vectors circulate. Climate change has enhanced dengue transmission potential by altering temperature and rainfall patterns that influence mosquito survival, reproduction, biting behaviour and viral replication. Containing or even reversing this global dengue expansion will require a complementary set of interventions that rely on proven and novel control strategies, including sterile insect techniques, Wolbachia‐ infected mosquitoes, virus‐resistant mosquito strains through CRISPR‐Cas9 gene drive, vaccines, antiviral drug prophylaxis and urban interventions that eliminate Aedes habitats. Building climate‐resilient urban environments through sustainable development to minimize the urban heat island effect and advancing climate‐informed early warning systems are long‐term strategies for effective dengue control.

papers.title: Reconstructing Dengue Exposure Dynamics and Assessing the Public Health Impact of Vaccination Scenarios Using Mathematical Models in Brazil
papers.abstract: Abstract Brazil experienced its worst dengue epidemic in 2024, with an increase in severe outcomes among elderly individuals, highlighting the need for vaccination strategies informed by population immunity. We reconstructed state- and age-specific immune profiles by fitting an age-structured catalytic model to dengue surveillance data from 2000–2025. This inferred immune profile was incorporated into an SIR-type transmission model to project disease burden and to evaluate the public health impact of vaccine allocation strategies. We observed substantial spatial heterogeneity in accumulated immunity, which was closely associated with projected burden and optimal allocation. Strategies prioritizing states with lower historical incidence and larger susceptible populations yielded greater benefits. Under limited vaccine supply, targeting children resulted in the greatest reductions in DALYs, whereas targeting elderly populations achieved smaller DALY reductions but larger reductions in mortality. We further showed that accelerated vaccine supply markedly increased impact, while allocation choices remained critical when availability was constrained.

This inferred immune profile was incorporated into an SIR-type transmission model to project disease burden and to evaluate the public health impact of vaccine allocation strategies. We observed substantial spatial heterogeneity in accumulated immunity, which was closely associated with projected burden and optimal allocation. Strategies prioritizing states with lower historical incidence and larger susceptible populations yielded greater benefits. Under limited vaccine supply, targeting children resulted in the greatest reductions in DALYs, whereas targeting elderly populations achieved smaller DALY reductions but larger reductions in mortality. We further showed that accelerated vaccine supply markedly increased impact, while allocation choices remained critical when availability was constrained.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在通过评估以人群免疫为基础的 疫苗接种 策略,应对巴西登革热疫情带来的公共卫生挑战,特别是 2024 年老年人中登革热疫情的严重程度。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及使用 2000 年至 2025 年登革热 监测 数据重建州和年龄特异性免疫特征,重点关注巴西的人口动态和疾病负担。
elements_zh.methods: 将年龄结构催化模型拟合到登革热 监测 数据以推断免疫特征,然后将其整合到 SIR 型 传播 模型中以预测疾病负担并评估 疫苗 分配策略。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究发现累积免疫力存在显着的空间异质性,这与预计的疾病负担和 疫苗 分配策略的有效性密切相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,优先考虑历史 疫苗 较低和易感人群较多的州的策略可以提供更大的公共卫生效益,为 疫苗 分布提供一种新颖的方法。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可为巴西制定有针对性的 疫苗接种 策略提供信息,特别是在免疫力较低和易感性较高的地区,以有效减轻疾病负担和 死亡率。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的结果基于建模数据,这可能会带来不确定性,并且由于依赖于历史 监测 数据而不是直接的实验测量,因此证据是温和的。

papers.title: Platelet Indices as Biomarkers of Disease Severity and Morbidity in Hospitalized Dengue Patients.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue fever is a rapidly expanding mosquito-borne illness with significant morbidity in children. While thrombocytopenia is a key feature, platelet count alone poorly predicts disease severity. Platelet indices such as mean platelet volume (MPV), platelet distribution width (PDW), and plateletcrit (PCT) may provide better insight into disease progression and complications. MATERIALS AND METHODS: This hospital-based cross-sectional observational study was conducted in the Department of Pediatrics, at a tertiary care hospital over 18 months. A total of 120 children aged 1-16 years with confirmed dengue infection (NS1 antigen or immunoglobulin M positive) were enrolled. Platelet indices were recorded at admission. Patients were classified according to the World Health Organization 2009 dengue severity criteria. Associations between platelet indices and disease severity, hepatic dysfunction, and renal dysfunction were analyzed using appropriate statistical tests. RESULTS: Among 120 patients, 35% had dengue without warning signs, 48.3% had warning signs, and 16.7% had severe dengue. MPV and PCT decreased, while PDW increased significantly with disease severity (P < 0.001). Hepatic (31.7%) and renal (9.2%) dysfunction were associated with lower MPV and PCT and higher PDW (P < 0.001). PDW showed a strong positive correlation with severity (r = 0.71), whereas MPV and PCT showed negative correlations. CONCLUSION: Platelet indices, particularly PDW and PCT, are simple, readily available, and reliable markers for predicting disease severity and organ dysfunction in pediatric dengue. Their routine use may aid early risk stratification, timely intervention, and improved clinical decision-making, especially in resource-limited settings where advanced biomarkers may not be accessible.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the utility of platelet indices as biomarkers for predicting disease severity and organ dysfunction in hospitalized children with dengue infection. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热 是一种迅速蔓延的蚊媒疾病,在儿童中发病率很高。虽然血小板减少症是一个关键特征,但仅凭血小板计数很难预测疾病的严重程度。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项以医院为基础的横断面观察性研究是在一家三级医院的儿科进行的,历时超过 18 个月。共有120名1-16岁确诊登革热感染(NS1抗原或免疫球蛋白M阳性)的儿童入组。根据世界卫生组织 2009 年登革热严重程度标准对患者进行分类。
elements_zh.methods: 入院时记录血小板指数,例如平均血小板体积(MPV)、血小板分布宽度(PDW)和血小板压积(PCT)。使用适当的统计检验分析血小板指数与疾病严重程度、肝功能障碍和肾功能障碍之间的关联。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 120 名患者中,35% 的患者患有登革热但没有警告信号,48.3% 的患者有警告信号,16.7% 的患者患有 重症登革热。随着疾病严重程度的增加,MPV 和 PCT 下降,而 PDW 显着增加(P < 0.001)。肝功能障碍 (31.7%) 和肾功能障碍 (9.2%) 与较低的 MPV 和 PCT 以及较高的 PDW 相关(P < 0.001)。PDW 与严重程度呈强正相关 (r = 0.71),而 MPV 和 PCT 呈负相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,血小板指数,特别是 PDW 和 PCT,比单独的血小板计数能更好地了解疾病进展和并发症。该研究引入 PDW 与疾病严重程度呈强正相关关系,这是一项新颖的发现。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能有助于开发简单、可靠且易于使用的生物标志物,用于预测儿科登革热的疾病严重程度和器官功能障碍,特别是在资源有限的环境中。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其横截面设计和潜在的混杂因素而受到限制。然而,证据是强有力的,因为它基于对明确定义的 队列研究 的直接观察和统计分析。

papers.title_zh: 血小板指数作为住院登革热患者疾病严重程度和发病率的生物标志物。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Dengue fever is a rapidly expanding mosquito-borne illness with significant morbidity in children. While thrombocytopenia is a key feature, platelet count alone poorly predicts disease severity. Platelet indices such as mean platelet volume (MPV), platelet distribution width (PDW), and plateletcrit (PCT) may provide better insight into disease progression and complications. MATERIALS AND METHODS: This hospital-based cross-sectional observational study was conducted in the Department of Pediatrics, at a tertiary care hospital over 18 months. A total of 120 children aged 1-16 years with confirmed dengue infection (NS1 antigen or immunoglobulin M positive) were enrolled. Platelet indices were recorded at admission. Patients were classified according to the World Health Organization 2009 dengue severity criteria. Associations between platelet indices and disease severity, hepatic dysfunction, and renal dysfunction were analyzed using appropriate statistical tests. RESULTS: Among 120 patients, 35% had dengue without warning signs, 48.3% had warning signs, and 16.7% had severe dengue. MPV and PCT decreased, while PDW increased significantly with disease severity (P < 0.001). Hepatic (31.7%) and renal (9.2%) dysfunction were associated with lower MPV and PCT and higher PDW (P < 0.001). PDW showed a strong positive correlation with severity (r = 0.71), whereas MPV and PCT showed negative correlations. CONCLUSION: Platelet indices, particularly PDW and PCT, are simple, readily available, and reliable markers for predicting disease severity and organ dysfunction in pediatric dengue. Their routine use may aid early risk stratification, timely intervention, and improved clinical decision-making, especially in resource-limited settings where advanced biomarkers may not be accessible.

papers.title: Bacterial immune priming and Wolbachia-mediated dengue blocking in Aedes albopictus mosquitoes.
papers.abstract: Background Wolbachia is a maternally-transmitted bacterial endosymbiont that is highly prevalent amongst arthropods. Many Wolbachia strains induce pathogen blocking, thereby protecting their hosts from pathogenic microbial infections. Blocking against pathogenic bacteria occurs in Aedes aegypti mosquitoes, where Wolbachia has been artificially established by microinjection. However, in Drosophila fruit flies, it occurs after oral bacterial challenge but not after systemic challenge via injection. Pathogen blocking has been linked to increased host immune activity associated with Wolbachia infection. This is similar in principle to immune priming, a memory immune response in insects, where sub-lethal exposure to a pathogen increases the ability to survive future infections. Aedes albopictus mosquitoes naturally harbor Wolbachia ; however, the extent to which native Wolbachia -mediated pathogen blocking and immune priming influence host response to infection remains unclear. Accordingly, we sought to characterize the response of Wolbachia -infected Ae. albopictus to bacterial challenge, and to determine whether the combination of these microbes could hinder a subsequent infection with dengue virus. Methodology/principal findings We challenged adult female Ae. albopictus with and without their native Wolbachia infection with a sub-lethal dose of four mosquito-associated bacteria: Micrococcus, Staphylococcus (gram positive), Brevundimonas , Enterobacter (gram negative). Assessing post-challenge mortality, we observed that Wolbachia infection reduced cumulative mortality and delayed the onset of senescence amongst mosquitoes challenged with each bacterium. However, this protective effect was stronger against gram positive bacteria. albopictus were then orally challenged with DENV. We observed that mosquitoes that experienced a pre-challenge with gram negative bacteria were associated with reduced DENV prevalence and viral load, whereas Wolbachia -infected mosquitoes exhibited further reductions in viral load. Conclusions/significance We highlight novel characteristics of native Wolbachia infection in Ae. albopictus mosquitoes, with protection against bacterial-induced mortality, and interactions between pathogen blocking and bacterial priming that may depend on bacterial gram status. These findings provide insight into the immune interactions associated with native Wolbachia and build on our understanding of adaptive immunity in mosquitoes.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the impact of native Wolbachia infection in Aedes albopictus mosquitoes on their response to bacterial challenges and subsequent dengue virus infection. The research highlights that Wolbachia reduces bacterial-induced mortality, with a stronger effect against gram-positive bacteria. Following bacterial exposure, mosquitoes were orally challenged with dengue virus, revealing reduced viral prevalence and load in those with gram-negative bacterial exposure and further reductions in Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes. The findings suggest that Wolbachia-mediated protection may interact with bacterial priming, depending on bacterial gram status. These results contribute to understanding immune mechanisms in mosquitoes and may inform strategies for dengue virus control. However, the study lacks detailed statistical analyses and long-term follow-up, which may limit the confidence in its conclusions.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及使用亚致死剂量的四种蚊子相关细菌来攻击有或没有感染沃尔巴克氏体的成年雌性白纹伊蚊,然后用 登革病毒 口服攻击它们。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员评估了暴露于细菌攻击和随后 登革病毒 的蚊子的攻击后 死亡率 和病毒载量,比较了感染沃尔巴克氏体和未感染的蚊子之间的结果。
elements_zh.main_results: 沃尔巴克氏体感染可减少受细菌攻击的蚊子的累积 死亡率 并延迟衰老,对革兰氏阳性菌具有更强的保护作用。预先用革兰氏阴性细菌攻击的蚊子表现出 登革病毒 患病率 和病毒载量的减少,而感染沃尔巴克氏体的蚊子的病毒载量进一步减少。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,白纹伊蚊中的原生沃尔巴克氏体感染可提供针对细菌诱导的 死亡率 的保护,并且病原体阻断和细菌引发之间的相互作用可能取决于细菌的克数状态。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果有助于了解涉及天然沃尔巴克氏体的免疫相互作用,并为通过免疫启动增强蚊子对 登革病毒 的抵抗力的潜在策略提供见解。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的证据基于观察结果,不包括详细的统计分析或长期随访,这可能会限制观察到的因果关系的可信度。

papers.abstract_zh: 背景沃尔巴克氏体是一种母源传播的细菌内共生体,在节肢动物中非常普遍。许多沃尔巴克氏体菌株诱导病原体阻断,从而保护其 宿主 免受病原微生物感染。对埃及伊蚊的病原菌的阻断发生在埃及伊蚊中,其中沃尔巴克氏体是通过显微注射人工建立的。然而,在果蝇中,它发生在口服细菌攻击后,而不是在通过注射进行全身攻击后。病原体阻断与沃尔巴克氏体感染相关的 宿主 免疫活性增加有关。这在原理上类似于免疫启动,即昆虫的记忆 免疫应答,其中亚致死暴露于病原体会增加在未来感染中生存的能力。白纹伊蚊天然携带沃尔巴克氏体;然而,天然沃尔巴克氏体介导的病原体阻断和免疫启动在多大程度上影响 宿主 对感染的反应仍不清楚。因此,我们试图描述感染沃尔巴克氏体的伊蚊的反应特征。白纹伊蚊进行细菌攻击,并确定这些微生物的组合是否可以阻碍 登革病毒 的后续感染。方法/主要发现 我们对成年女性 Ae 提出了挑战。白纹伊蚊感染或不感染原生沃尔巴克氏体,感染亚致死剂量的四种与蚊子相关的细菌:微球菌、葡萄球菌(革兰氏阳性)、短波单胞菌、肠杆菌(革兰氏阴性)。评估攻击后 死亡率,我们观察到沃尔巴克氏体感染减少了累积的 死亡率 并延迟了用每种细菌攻击的蚊子的衰老开始。然而,这种保护作用对革兰氏阳性菌更强。然后对白纹伊蚊进行口服 DENV 攻击。我们观察到,经历过革兰氏阴性细菌预攻击的蚊子与 DENV 患病率 和病毒载量减少有关,而感染沃尔巴克氏体的蚊子则表现出病毒载量进一步减少。结论/意义 我们强调了伊蚊本地沃尔巴克氏体感染的新特征。白纹伊蚊,具有针对细菌诱导的 死亡率 的保护,以及病原体阻断和细菌引发之间的相互作用,这可能取决于细菌革兰氏状态。这些发现提供了对与本土沃尔巴克氏体相关的免疫相互作用的深入了解,并建立在我们对蚊子适应性免疫的理解之上。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在调查白纹伊蚊的本土沃尔巴克氏体感染如何影响其对细菌挑战的反应,以及这种相互作用是否会影响随后的 登革病毒 感染。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及使用亚致死剂量的四种蚊子相关细菌来攻击有或没有感染沃尔巴克氏体的成年雌性白纹伊蚊,然后用 登革病毒 口服攻击它们。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员评估了暴露于细菌攻击和随后 登革病毒 的蚊子的攻击后 死亡率 和病毒载量,比较了感染沃尔巴克氏体和未感染的蚊子之间的结果。
analysis_zh.main_results: 沃尔巴克氏体感染可减少受细菌攻击的蚊子的累积 死亡率 并延迟衰老,对革兰氏阳性菌具有更强的保护作用。预先用革兰氏阴性细菌攻击的蚊子表现出 登革病毒 患病率 和病毒载量的减少,而感染沃尔巴克氏体的蚊子的病毒载量进一步减少。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,白纹伊蚊中的原生沃尔巴克氏体感染可提供针对细菌诱导的 死亡率 的保护,并且病原体阻断和细菌引发之间的相互作用可能取决于细菌的克数状态。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果有助于了解涉及天然沃尔巴克氏体的免疫相互作用,并为通过免疫启动增强蚊子对 登革病毒 的抵抗力的潜在策略提供见解。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的证据基于观察结果,不包括详细的统计分析或长期随访,这可能会限制观察到的因果关系的可信度。

papers.title: Solanaceae-Derived Spirostane Saponins Inhibit Dengue Virus Replication and Viral Protein Expression and Exhibit Activity Against Multiple Arboviruses.
papers.abstract: Mosquito-borne arboviruses, including dengue virus (DENV), Zika virus (ZIKV), and chikungunya virus (CHIKV), represent a growing global health burden, yet no specific antiviral therapies are currently available for most of these infections. This unmet need highlights the importance of identifying novel antiviral compounds from biologically relevant sources such as plant-derived natural products. In this study, a bioactivity-guided approach was applied to methanolic extracts from eight Solanaceae species to identify compounds with antiviral activity against DENV-2 in Vero cells. Five extracts significantly reduced viral infectivity, with Solanum ovalifolium and Cestrum sp. achieving complete inhibition at non-cytotoxic concentrations. Subsequent fractionation and purification led to the isolation of four spirostane-type steroidal saponins, structurally characterized by UPLC-DAD-MS and 1D/2D NMR spectroscopy. Functional assays demonstrated that these compounds inhibit DENV replication, as evidenced by marked reductions in viral RNA levels, NS1 and NS3 protein expression, and infectious viral titers. Stage-specific analyses revealed that their antiviral activity is primarily associated with intracellular phases of the viral life cycle, consistent with inhibition of viral replication and/or protein processing. Molecular docking analyses supported these findings by predicting favorable interactions with key viral enzymes, particularly NS5 RNA-dependent RNA polymerase and NS3 helicase/protease. Importantly, the isolated compounds retained antiviral activity against ZIKV and CHIKV, indicating cross-arboviral efficacy. Together, these findings identify spirostane saponins as promising antiviral scaffolds and support their further development as broad-spectrum antiviral agents.

papers.title_zh: 茄科来源的螺甾烷皂苷抑制登革病毒复制和病毒蛋白表达,并对多种虫媒病毒表现活性。

papers.abstract_zh: 蚊媒虫媒病毒(包括登革病毒(DENV)、寨卡病毒(ZIKV)和基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV))构成了日益增长的全球健康负担,但目前针对这些感染的特异性抗病毒药物疗法尚不普及。这种未满足的医疗需求凸显了从生物相关来源(如植物来源的天然产物)中识别新型抗病毒药物化合物的重要性。本研究采用基于生物活性的筛选方法,对八种茄科植物的甲醇提取物进行分析,以鉴定具有抗病毒药物活性的化合物,针对Vero细胞中DENV-2的感染。五种提取物显著降低了病毒的感染性,其中Solanum ovalifolium和Cestrum sp.在非细胞毒性浓度下实现了完全抑制。随后的分级和纯化过程分离出四种螺甾烷型甾体皂苷,其结构通过超高效液相色谱-二极管阵列检测-质谱(UPLC-DAD-MS)和一维/二维核磁共振(1D/2D NMR)光谱进行表征。功能实验表明,这些化合物抑制DENV复制,表现为病毒RNA水平、NS1和NS3蛋白表达以及传染性病毒滴度的显著下降。阶段特异性分析显示,其抗病毒药物活性主要与病毒生命周期的细胞内阶段相关,这与抑制病毒复制和/或蛋白质加工一致。分子对接分析支持这些发现,预测这些化合物与关键病毒酶(特别是NS5 RNA依赖性RNA聚合酶和NS3解旋酶/蛋白酶)具有有利的相互作用。重要的是,分离出的化合物对ZIKV和CHIKV也表现出抗病毒药物活性,表明其具有跨虫媒病毒的疗效。综上所述,这些发现表明螺甾烷皂苷是具有前景的抗病毒药物骨架,并支持其进一步开发为广谱抗病毒药物药物。

papers.title: Computational Insights Into the Conformational Dynamics of the Dengue Virus Capsid Protein.
papers.abstract: The Dengue virus (DENV) capsid protein plays an important role in the viral lifecycle, including encapsidation of the genome, recruitment of lipid droplets, and assembly of particles. Capsid protein includes a hydrophobic pocket, which plays a central role in these functions and switches between closed and open conformations. This work studies the conformational change pathway of the capsid protein, specifically how the molecular mechanisms controlling the opening and closing of the hydrophobic pocket are controlled. By using a combination of different types of molecular dynamics simulations and enhanced sampling methods, we share insights on the structural rearrangements that play a crucial role in governing these transitions. Our results show that lipid binding modulates the accessibility of the hydrophobic pocket through environmental cues. In the open conformation, the pocket is involved in the interaction with lipids, stabilization of capsid dimers, and the promotion of immature virus assembly. Conversely, the closed conformation protects the hydrophobic pocket from the surrounding aqueous media as also preventing premature interactions in the solution phase that might disrupt protein stability. Such insights allow a deep understanding of capsid protein's conformational dynamics and represent a promising set of potent targets for antiviral strategies aiming to interfere with its functional transitions.

papers.title_zh: 对 登革病毒 衣壳蛋白构象动力学的计算见解。

papers.abstract_zh: 登革病毒 (DENV) 衣壳蛋白在病毒生命周期中发挥重要作用,包括 基因组 的衣壳化、脂滴的招募和颗粒的组装。衣壳蛋白包含一个疏水口袋,它在这些功能以及闭合和开放构象之间的转换中发挥着核心作用。这项工作研究了衣壳蛋白的构象变化途径,特别是如何控制控制疏水袋打开和关闭的分子机制。通过结合使用不同类型的分子动力学模拟和增强的采样方法,我们分享了对在控制这些转变中发挥关键作用的结构重排的见解。我们的结果表明,脂质结合通过环境因素调节疏水袋的可及性。在开放构象中,口袋参与与脂质的相互作用、衣壳二聚体的稳定以及促进未成熟病毒的组装。相反,闭合构象可以保护疏水袋免受周围水介质的影响,同时还可以防止溶液相中过早的相互作用,从而破坏蛋白质的稳定性。这些见解使人们能够深入了解衣壳蛋白的构象动力学,并为旨在干扰其功能转变的 抗病毒药物 策略提供了一组有前景的有效靶标。

papers.title: New Perspectives in Prevention, Control, and Treatment of Dengue Fever
papers.abstract: Dengue is a mosquito-borne viral disease primarily transmitted by Aedes aegypti and is endemic in tropical and subtropical regions worldwide. It represents a major global public health challenge because of its rapid expansion and increasing incidence. Clinical manifestations range from mild febrile illness to severe disease with hemorrhage and death. No specific antiviral treatment exists, and prevention has relied on vector control to reduce human–mosquito contact. Although vaccines are available, access remains limited. In the Americas, dengue transmission has intensified markedly in recent years. The largest epidemic occurred in 2024, with more than 12.6 million cases and over 7700 deaths. In 2025, reports showed 4 million suspected cases, including 8966 severe cases and 2207 deaths. This persistent burden may be driven by climate variability, urbanization, mobility, environmental change, and widespread vector distribution, all of which contribute to ongoing transmission and disease severity. These trends underscore the critical need to strengthen surveillance, improve integrated vector management, expand vaccine access, and develop effective therapies to reduce the health, social, and economic impact of this disease. Accordingly, effective preventive and therapeutic strategies are needed to address this persistent and growing threat.

analysis.summary_en: This review article focuses on dengue virus, a mosquito-borne pathogen primarily transmitted by Aedes aegypti, which is endemic in tropical and subtropical regions. The article highlights the growing global public health challenge posed by dengue, emphasizing its increasing incidence and rapid expansion. Clinical manifestations range from mild febrile illness to severe disease with hemorrhage and death, and while vaccines are available, access remains limited. The review notes that dengue transmission has intensified in the Americas, with the largest epidemic occurring in 2024, and reports of 4 million suspected cases in 2025, including severe cases and deaths. The persistent burden is attributed to factors such as climate variability, urbanization, and environmental change. The article underscores the need for improved surveillance, integrated vector management, expanded vaccine access, and the development of effective therapies to mitigate the health, social, and economic impacts of dengue.

papers.source_body_en: Dengue is a mosquito-borne viral disease primarily transmitted by Aedes aegypti and is endemic in tropical and subtropical regions worldwide. It represents a major global public health challenge because of its rapid expansion and increasing incidence. Clinical manifestations range from mild febrile illness to severe disease with hemorrhage and death. No specific antiviral treatment exists, and prevention has relied on vector control to reduce human–mosquito contact. Although vaccines are available, access remains limited. In the Americas, dengue transmission has intensified markedly in recent years. The largest epidemic occurred in 2024, with more than 12.6 million cases and over 7700 deaths. In 2025, reports showed 4 million suspected cases, including 8966 severe cases and 2207 deaths. This persistent burden may be driven by climate variability, urbanization, mobility, environmental change, and widespread vector distribution, all of which contribute to ongoing transmission and disease severity. These trends underscore the critical need to strengthen surveillance, improve integrated vector management, expand vaccine access, and develop effective therapies to reduce the health, social, and economic impact of this disease. Accordingly, effective preventive and therapeutic strategies are needed to address this persistent and growing threat.

papers.title: The Role of Temperature, Rainfall, and Humidity in Driving Dengue Virus Transmission in Urban Environments: A Systematic Literature Review
papers.abstract: This systematic literature review addresses critical limitations in climate-driven vector disease models, which currently rely on macro-level climatic or socioeconomic indicators—such as state-level Human Development Index scores—and fail to account for intra-urban microclimates, Urban Heat Island (UHI) effects, and localized human mobility. Furthermore, urban climate adaptation measures like engineered green infrastructure can inadvertently create thermal refuges and breeding sites for invasive vectors such as Aedes albopictus and Anopheles stephensi, while passive public health surveillance routinely omits asymptomatic disease transmission. To bridge these interdisciplinary gaps, the study aims to evaluate fine-scale intra-urban microclimatic and ecological drivers, synthesize high-resolution spatial-temporal and machine learning predictive forecasting models, and formulate a cross-sectoral urban health preparedness model that aligns urban planning with vector control. Focusing on human populations within urban environments in India, the review evaluates peer-reviewed journal articles published between 2017 and 2026. Literature is identified using the query string TITLE-ABS-KEY (("urban population") AND ("climate" OR "temperature" OR "rain" OR "humidity" OR "weather") AND ("dengue" OR "dengue virus")) AND PUBYEAR > 2016 AND PUBYEAR < 2027. The review specifically includes prospective observational cohort studies and high-resolution spatial-temporal modeling research that evaluate localized ambient or surface temperature, relative humidity, rainfall, green infrastructure, and sub-neighborhood disease incidence. Studies evaluating travel-imported cases, laboratory-controlled mosquitoes without human settlement data, spatially aggregated macro-level proxies, non-thermal climate variables in isolation, qualitative-only designs, or unvalidated software and poster documentation are excluded. Ultimately, this review synthesizes evidence on how localized microclimatic variations and green infrastructure influence vector ecology and dengue virus transmission. By integrating real-time serological surveillance, micro-environmental data, vector indices, and ensemble forecasting techniques, the framework advances beyond passive surveillance to provide actionable evidence for municipal urban planners and public health officials

elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 通过整合实时血清学 监测、微环境数据、媒介 指数和集合预测技术,该框架超越了被动的 监测,为城市规划者和公共卫生官员提供了可操作的证据。

papers.abstract_zh: 这项系统文献综述探讨了气候驱动的登革热模型中的关键局限性,这些模型目前依赖于宏观层面的气候或社会经济指标——例如州级的人类发展指数(HDI)得分——而未能考虑城市内部的微气候、城市热岛(UHI)效应以及局部人类活动。此外,城市气候适应措施,如人工绿色基础设施,可能会无意中创造热避难所并为入侵性登革热媒介如埃及伊蚊(Aedes albopictus)和按蚊(Anopheles stephensi)提供繁殖场所,而被动公共卫生措施通常忽略无症状疾病的传播。为弥合这些跨学科的差距,本研究旨在评估城市内部微气候和生态驱动因素的精细尺度,综合高分辨率时空和机器学习预测性预报模型,并制定一个跨部门的城市健康准备模型,将城市规划与登革热控制相结合。本综述聚焦于印度城市环境中的人群,评估了2017年至2026年间发表的同行评审期刊文章。文献检索使用查询字符串 TITLE-ABS-KEY (("urban population") AND ("climate" OR "temperature" OR "rain" OR "humidity" OR "weather") AND ("dengue" OR "登革热")) AND PUBYEAR > 2016 AND PUBYEAR < 2027。综述特别包括前瞻性观察性研究和高分辨率时空建模研究,这些研究评估了局部环境或地表温度、相对湿度、降雨量、绿色基础设施以及次邻里范围内的疾病传播。排除了评估旅行输入病例、实验室控制的蚊虫(缺乏人类聚居地数据)、空间聚合的宏观层面代理变量、孤立的非热气候变量、仅定性设计或未经验证的软件和海报文档的研究。最终,本综述综合了证据,说明局部微气候变化和绿色基础设施如何影响登革热的生态和传播。通过整合实时血清学数据、微环境数据、登革热指数以及集成预测技术,该框架超越了被动公共卫生措施,为市政城市规划者和公共卫生官员提供可操作的证据

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 这篇系统文献综述解决了气候驱动的 媒介 疾病模型的关键局限性,该模型目前依赖于宏观层面的气候或社会经济指标(例如州级人类发展指数得分),并且未能考虑城市内的微气候、城市热岛 (UHI) 效应和局部人口流动。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述特别包括前瞻性观测 队列研究 研究和高分辨率时空建模研究,用于评估局部环境或表面温度、相对湿度、降雨量、绿色基础设施和子社区疾病 发病率。评估旅行输入病例、没有人类住区数据的实验室控制蚊子、空间聚合的宏观代理、孤立的非热气候变量、纯定性设计或未经验证的软件和海报文档的研究被排除在外。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综述综合了局部微气候变化和绿色基础设施如何影响 媒介 生态和 登革病毒 传播 的证据。它强调需要将微环境数据集成到预测模型中,以更好地理解和管理城市环境中的 登革病毒 传播。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 城市气候适应措施(例如工程绿色基础设施)可能会无意中为白纹伊蚊和斯氏按蚊等入侵性 媒介 创造热避难所和繁殖地。被动公共卫生监测通常会忽略无症状疾病传播,这可能会影响当前模型的准确性。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 通过整合实时血清学 监测、微环境数据、媒介 指数和集合预测技术,该框架超越了被动的 监测,为城市规划者和公共卫生官员提供了可操作的证据。

Ceará has been a dengue hyperendemic region, where all 4 DENV serotypes co-circulate, predominantly DENV-1 and DENV-2, and where DENV-3 was recently reintroduced. Our findings provide an epidemiologic baseline for postlicensure dengue vaccine evaluation.

papers.full_text: Disclaimer: Early release articles are not considered as final versions. Any changes will be reflected in the online version in the month the article is officially released. Volume 32, Number 11—November 2026 Dispatch Transmission Dynamics of Dengue Virus, Ceará State, Brazil, 2010–2025 Suggested citation for this article Abstract We evaluated the transmission dynamics of dengue virus (DENV) during 2010–2025 in Ceará State, Brazil. Ceará has been a dengue hyperendemic region, where all 4 DENV serotypes co-circulate, predominantly DENV-1 and DENV-2, and where DENV-3 was recently reintroduced. Our findings provide an epidemiologic baseline for postlicensure dengue vaccine evaluation. Dengue virus (DENV) is an arbovirus estimated to cause >390 million infections annually worldwide, leading to >10,000 deaths in >125 countries (1,2). DENV (Flaviviridae family) is transmitted to humans primarily by Aedes aegypti and Ae. albopictus mosquitoes (3) and comprises 4 genetically and antigenically distinct serotypes (DENV-1–4) (4). DENV infection can be categorized as dengue without warning signs, dengue with warning signs, and severe dengue, which can include death (5). No specific antiviral treatment is available for dengue. As of August 2026, Dengvaxia (Sanofi Pasteur, https://www.sanofi.us), Qdenga TAK-003 (Takeda, https://www.takeda.com), and Butantan-DV (Instituto Butantan, https://en.butantan.gov.br) are 3 licensed vaccines to prevent dengue; however, Dengvaxia use remains limited because of safety concerns (6,7). Brazil remains one of the most affected countries by dengue and has annual epidemics, widespread vector distribution, and co-circulation of all 4 DENV serotypes (8). We integrate epidemiologic and genomic methods to investigate DENV transmission dynamics during 2010–2025 in Ceará, a hyperendemic state in Brazil. We retroactively obtained national epidemiologic data on laboratory-confirmed dengue cases during January 2010–January 2025 from Brazil’s Ministry of Health. We obtained additional epidemiologic data from the Central Laboratory of Public Health of Ceará for dengue cases reported during July 2014–June 2025. We used the MiSeq platform (Illumina, https://www.illumina.com) to sequence residual quantitative reverse transcription PCR–positive DENV serum samples collected from case-patients with DENV-1–3 serotypes during February 2024–July 2025. We assigned DENV lineages by using the DENV typing tool (9), followed by phylogenetic reconstruction. We also performed time-series, spatial mapping, and demographic analyses (Appendix). During January 3, 2010–January 25, 2025, Brazil reported 1,657,046 laboratory-confirmed dengue cases across 98.9% (5,509/5,570) of municipalities in all 26 states and the Federal District. We identified 13 major epidemic waves at the national level; annual incidence varied from 4.0 to 190.4 cases/100,000 inhabitants, and the largest epidemic occurred in 2024 (Figure 1, panel A). National DENV testing positivity rate ranged from 18.2% (19,460/106,901 inhabitants) to 57.1% (146,649/256,981 inhabitants) during those 15 years (Figure 1, panel B). In Ceará, a total of 131,961 laboratory-confirmed cases were reported, corresponding to a cumulative incidence of 1,500 cases/100,000 inhabitants. Ceará epidemic peaks coincided with national trends but frequently reached higher incidence and positivity rates (Figure 1). By 2026, dengue had been reported in all 184 municipalities in Ceará; cumulative incidences range from 41.4 to 8,566 cases/100,000 inhabitants (Appendix). Nationally, dengue epidemics occurred mainly during February–June and peaked during March–April (peak monthly incidence mean 10.4 cases/100,000 inhabitants). In contrast, in Ceará, epidemics occurred during March–August, typically peaking in May (incidence mean 18.4 cases/100,000 inhabitants) (Appendix). Sex- and age-stratified analyses revealed a female-to-male ratio of 1.6 and higher incidence among female persons nationally (2-way ANOVA test, p<0.05) and in Ceará (p<0.01) (Appendix). The cumulative incidence in Ceará was higher in persons 10–39 years of age than in persons >70 years of age (p<0.05) (Appendix). We investigated the circulation of DENV serotypes in Ceará during July 2014–June 2025. DENV-1 was the predominant DENV serotype during 2014–2019 and again during 2023–2025 (Figures 2, 3). Fortaleza, the capital and most populous city in Ceará, reported co-circulation of DENV-1, DENV-3, and DENV-4 in 2015. DENV-2 reemerged in 2019, leading to its near-complete replacement of other DENV serotypes in 2021 and 2022 (Figures 2, 3). To assess current genetic diversity in Ceará, we sequenced 243 DENV genomes from cases reported during February 2024–July 2025 across 45 municipalities (Figure 4; Appendix). Cycle threshold values ranged from 10.6 to 33.0. We recovered complete or partial DENV genomes for 218 of the 243 samples (coverage 14.4%–99.2%; mean depth 16–9,877 per nucleotide) (Appendix). Among those genomes, we classified 82.6% (180/218) with >70% coverage into the following genotypes: DENV-1 V_D1.1 (n = 1), DENV-1 V_E1 (n = 111), DENV-2 II_F1.1.2 (n = 61), DENV-2 II_F1.1.5 (n = 2), DENV-2 III_C1.1 (n = 2), and DENV-3 III_B3.2 (n = 3) (9). We included those newly generated DENV genome sequences in maximum-likelihood phylogenetic analyses along with global DENV genome references (Appendix). Phylogenetic analysis showed that the recent epidemic in Ceará (2024–2025) was mainly caused by DENV-1 lineage V_E1 (61.6% [n = 111 cases]). DENV lineages identified in Ceará were distributed across multiple well-supported subclades with genomes from southeast (São Paulo), central-west (Federal District, Goiás, and Mato Grosso do Sul), and northeast (Alagoas) of Brazil and from Florida (USA) and Uruguay. Lineage II_F1.1.2 (94%) predominated among DENV-2 cases, and clustered with DENV genomes from southeast and northeast Brazil and the United States (10). Conversely, DENV-2 II_F1.1.5 genomes grouped with sequences from France (2023–2024) and the Dominican Republic (2024), suggesting a recent international introduction. Detection of DENV-3 genomes from Ceará was consistent with a reintroduction because no local detections have occurred since 2015. Those genomes belonged to lineage III_B3.2 and formed a well-supported clade (bootstrap 100%) with sequences from São Paulo (2024–2025) and Florida (2023) within a lineage widely circulating across the Americas, including in Cuba, the Dominican Republic, French Guiana, and Peru (Figure 4). This study provides a 15-year overview of dengue transmission in Ceará, a dengue hyperendemic state. Our epidemiologic analyses demonstrate that dengue occurred in all 184 municipalities of Ceará and that multiple DENV epidemics reached higher incidence and testing positivity rates than national trends. Epidemic peaks typically occurred ≈1 month later and lasted longer in Ceará than the national average, which might be explained by extended periods of high temperature and humidity (11), supporting near year-round vector abundance and sustained DENV transmission (3). We identified heterogeneous circulation of all 4 DENV serotypes and identified 6 distinct viral lineages across 3 serotypes (DENV-1, DENV-2, and DENV-3) sustained by multiple national and international introductions. We also documented the reintroduction of DENV-3, confirmed by its detection in July 2025, which could increase the risk for severe outcomes in the coming years through sequential infections and antibody-dependent enhancement after a decade of co-circulation of DENV-1 and DENV-2 (12). Moreover, our phylogenetic analyses showed that DENV-3 lineage III_B3.2 genomes clustered with DENV sequences detected during 2024–2025 in São Paulo State. That finding suggests a recent introduction of DENV-3 into Ceará through domestic routes, after its dissemination and sustained circulation across different regions of Brazil, rather than importation from the Caribbean and the Americas (13,14). One limitation of our study is its reliance on variable healthcare-seeking behaviors, which might not capture the full extent of dengue cases, including asymptomatic cases. In addition, on the basis of our epidemiological data, we cannot distinguish between primary and secondary DENV infections. Moreover, we acknowledge that some dengue cases diagnosed by IgM detection might reflect cross-reactivity with Zika virus, which emerged in Brazil in 2015 (15). Furthermore, our genomic data are limited to 2024–2025, which, together with the scarcity of DENV genomic data from Ceará in public genomic databases, prevents elucidation of the spatial and temporal dynamics of DENV lineages in Ceará before 2024. In summary, our study described the long-term dengue transmission dynamics in Ceará, Brazil, during 2010–2025 and substantially increased the DENV genomic data from this hyperendemic region. Such genomic data enable identification of circulating and emerging DENV lineages, elucidating the spatiotemporal evolution and shifts in DENV patterns. Our findings will guide public health management and future efforts to implement dengue immunization programs using Qdenga TAK-003 and Butantan-DV in Brazil. Co-circulation of all DENV serotypes, and the current predominance of DENV-1 and DENV-2, highlight the necessity for continued serotype-specific surveillance to further monitor vaccine effectiveness. Her research interests include epidemiologic surveillance of arboviruses and emerging RNA viruses. Any changes will be reflected in the online version in the month the article is officially released. Volume 32, Number 11—November 2026 Dispatch Transmission Dynamics of Dengue Virus, Ceará State, Brazil, 2010–2025 Suggested citation for this article Abstract We evaluated the transmission dynamics of dengue virus (DENV) during 2010–2025 in Ceará State, Brazil. Ceará has been a dengue hyperendemic region, where all 4 DENV serotypes co-circulate, predominantly DENV-1 and DENV-2, and where DENV-3 was recently reintroduced. Our findings provide an epidemiologic baseline for postlicensure dengue vaccine evaluation. Dengue virus (DENV) is an arbovirus estimated to cause >390 million infections annually worldwide, leading to >10,000 deaths in >125 countries (1,2). DENV (Flaviviridae family) is transmitted to humans primarily by Aedes aegypti and Ae. albopictus mosquitoes (3) and comprises 4 genetically and antigenically distinct serotypes (DENV-1–4) (4). DENV infection can be categorized as dengue without warning signs, dengue with warning signs, and severe dengue, which can include death (5). No specific antiviral treatment is available for dengue. As of August 2026, Dengvaxia (Sanofi Pasteur, https://www.sanofi.us), Qdenga TAK-003 (Takeda, https://www.takeda.com), and Butantan-DV (Instituto Butantan, https://en.butantan.gov.br) are 3 licensed vaccines to prevent dengue; however, Dengvaxia use remains limited because of safety concerns (6,7). Brazil remains one of the most affected countries by dengue and has annual epidemics, widespread vector distribution, and co-circulation of all 4 DENV serotypes (8). We integrate epidemiologic and genomic methods to investigate DENV transmission dynamics during 2010–2025 in Ceará, a hyperendemic state in Brazil. We retroactively obtained national epidemiologic data on laboratory-confirmed dengue cases during January 2010–January 2025 from Brazil’s Ministry of Health. We obtained additional epidemiologic data from the Central Laboratory of Public Health of Ceará for dengue cases reported during July 2014–June 2025. We used the MiSeq platform (Illumina, https://www.illumina.com) to sequence residual quantitative reverse transcription PCR–positive DENV serum samples collected from case-patients with DENV-1–3 serotypes during February 2024–July 2025. We assigned DENV lineages by using the DENV typing tool (9), followed by phylogenetic reconstruction. We also performed time-series, spatial mapping, and demographic analyses (Appendix). During January 3, 2010–January 25, 2025, Brazil reported 1,657,046 laboratory-confirmed dengue cases across 98.9% (5,509/5,570) of municipalities in all 26 states and the Federal District. We identified 13 major epidemic waves at the national level; annual incidence varied from 4.0 to 190.4 cases/100,000 inhabitants, and the largest epidemic occurred in 2024 (Figure 1, panel A). National DENV testing positivity rate ranged from 18.2% (19,460/106,901 inhabitants) to 57.1% (146,649/256,981 inhabitants) during those 15 years (Figure 1, panel B). In Ceará, a total of 131,961 laboratory-confirmed cases were reported, corresponding to a cumulative incidence of 1,500 cases/100,000 inhabitants. Ceará epidemic peaks coincided with national trends but frequently reached higher incidence and positivity rates (Figure 1). By 2026, dengue had been reported in all 184 municipalities in Ceará; cumulative incidences range from 41.4 to 8,566 cases/100,000 inhabitants (Appendix). Nationally, dengue epidemics occurred mainly during February–June and peaked during March–April (peak monthly incidence mean 10.4 cases/100,000 inhabitants). In contrast, in Ceará, epidemics occurred during March–August, typically peaking in May (incidence mean 18.4 cases/100,000 inhabitants) (Appendix). Sex- and age-stratified analyses revealed a female-to-male ratio of 1.6 and higher incidence among female persons nationally (2-way ANOVA test, p<0.05) and in Ceará (p<0.01) (Appendix). The cumulative incidence in Ceará was higher in persons 10–39 years of age than in persons >70 years of age (p<0.05) (Appendix). We investigated the circulation of DENV serotypes in Ceará during July 2014–June 2025. DENV-1 was the predominant DENV serotype during 2014–2019 and again during 2023–2025 (Figures 2, 3). Fortaleza, the capital and most populous city in Ceará, reported co-circulation of DENV-1, DENV-3, and DENV-4 in 2015. DENV-2 reemerged in 2019, leading to its near-complete replacement of other DENV serotypes in 2021 and 2022 (Figures 2, 3). To assess current genetic diversity in Ceará, we sequenced 243 DENV genomes from cases reported during February 2024–July 2025 across 45 municipalities (Figure 4; Appendix). Cycle threshold values ranged from 10.6 to 33.0. We recovered complete or partial DENV genomes for 218 of the 243 samples (coverage 14.4%–99.2%; mean depth 16–9,877 per nucleotide) (Appendix). Among those genomes, we classified 82.6% (180/218) with >70% coverage into the following genotypes: DENV-1 V_D1.1 (n = 1), DENV-1 V_E1 (n = 111), DENV-2 II_F1.1.2 (n = 61), DENV-2 II_F1.1.5 (n = 2), DENV-2 III_C1.1 (n = 2), and DENV-3 III_B3.2 (n = 3) (9). We included those newly generated DENV genome sequences in maximum-likelihood phylogenetic analyses along with global DENV genome references (Appendix). Phylogenetic analysis showed that the recent epidemic in Ceará (2024–2025) was mainly caused by DENV-1 lineage V_E1 (61.6% [n = 111 cases]). DENV lineages identified in Ceará were distributed across multiple well-supported subclades with genomes from southeast (São Paulo), central-west (Federal District, Goiás, and Mato Grosso do Sul), and northeast (Alagoas) of Brazil and from Florida (USA) and Uruguay. Lineage II_F1.1.2 (94%) predominated among DENV-2 cases, and clustered with DENV genomes from southeast and northeast Brazil and the United States (10). Conversely, DENV-2 II_F1.1.5 genomes grouped with sequences from France (2023–2024) and the Dominican Republic (2024), suggesting a recent international introduction. Detection of DENV-3 genomes from Ceará was consistent with a reintroduction because no local detections have occurred since 2015. Those genomes belonged to lineage III_B3.2 and formed a well-supported clade (bootstrap 100%) with sequences from São Paulo (2024–2025) and Florida (2023) within a lineage widely circulating across the Americas, including in Cuba, the Dominican Republic, French Guiana, and Peru (Figure 4). This study provides a 15-year overview of dengue transmission in Ceará, a dengue hyperendemic state. Our epidemiologic analyses demonstrate that dengue occurred in all 184 municipalities of Ceará and that multiple DENV epidemics reached higher incidence and testing positivity rates than national trends. Epidemic peaks typically occurred ≈1 month later and lasted longer in Ceará than the national average, which might be explained by extended periods of high temperature and humidity (11), supporting near year-round vector abundance and sustained DENV transmission (3). We identified heterogeneous circulation of all 4 DENV serotypes and identified 6 distinct viral lineages across 3 serotypes (DENV-1, DENV-2, and DENV-3) sustained by multiple national and international introductions. We also documented the reintroduction of DENV-3, confirmed by its detection in July 2025, which could increase the risk for severe outcomes in the coming years through sequential infections and antibody-dependent enhancement after a decade of co-circulation of DENV-1 and DENV-2 (12). Moreover, our phylogenetic analyses showed that DENV-3 lineage III_B3.2 genomes clustered with DENV sequences detected during 2024–2025 in São Paulo State. That finding suggests a recent introduction of DENV-3 into Ceará through domestic routes, after its dissemination and sustained circulation across different regions of Brazil, rather than importation from the Caribbean and the America…

papers.title: Risk factors associated with dengue fever outbreak in Harf Sufyan district-Amran governorate, Yemen, 2023: case control study
papers.abstract: Dengue Fever (DF) is endemic in Yemen. On September 4th, 2023, the surveillance officer in Amran governorate reported an increased number of suspected DF in Harf-Sufyan district. On September 5th, 2023, a team from electronic Integrated Disease Early Warning System eIDEWS and Rapid Response (RR) program was sent to investigate. This study aimed to confirm the existence of the outbreak, determine risk factors, and recommend control measures. papers.title: Temporal trends of dengue exposure among children in coastal Kenya
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Serosurveys suggest widespread dengue virus (DENV) transmission in Africa but there is limited information on the temporal patterns of exposure. Methods Using repeated cross-sectional serosurvey data, we estimated the prevalence and incidence of DENV infections in coastal Kenya over 20 years (1998–2018). Stored sera ( n = 8025), collected annually from an open longitudinal cohort of 1834 children aged 15 years and below, were screened for anti-DENV IgG antibodies. Results We show that, of 8025 samples, 2287 (28.5%, 95% CI 27.5–29.5%) were seropositive for DENV IgG antibodies. Seroprevalence increased with age, from 2% among children aged below 1 year to 40% among those aged 9 to 10 years, and peaked during outbreak years. Among 1343 children who were seronegative at recruitment, the overall incidence (seroconversion) rate was 111.5 DENV infections per 1000 person-years (95% CI 102.5–121.2). The highest incidence occurred in 2013 at 439.7 infections per 1000 person-years (95% CI 375.1–515.5), coinciding with a large outbreak in coastal Kenya. Conclusions Our findings suggest long-term DENV exposure among children in coastal Kenya and highlight an urgent need for clinical surveillance to determine the associated health burden.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the temporal trends of dengue virus (DENV) exposure among children in coastal Kenya using repeated cross-sectional serosurvey data from 1998 to 2018. The research highlights the widespread prevalence of DENV infections, with seroprevalence increasing with age and peaking during outbreak years. The study found that 28.5% of 8025 samples were seropositive for DENV IgG antibodies, with the highest incidence recorded in 2013 at 439.7 infections per 1000 person-years. These results underscore the long-term exposure to DENV among children in the region and emphasize the need for enhanced clinical surveillance to assess the health burden. The study's design, while robust, does not explicitly report limitations, which may affect the confidence in the findings.

papers.title: Identification and Expression Characterization of Leucine-Rich Repeat Proteins in Aedes albopictus in Response to Dengue Virus Infection
papers.abstract: Mosquitoes transmit a wide range of human pathogens, including Plasmodium parasites and arboviruses. Insects rely primarily on pattern recognition receptors (PRRs) to initiate innate immunity against invading pathogens. Leucine-rich repeat proteins (LRRPs), such as LRIM1 and APL1, are critical PRRs that mediate anti- Plasmodium immunity in Anopheles mosquitoes. However, the roles of these proteins in Aedes albopictus, a major vector of dengue virus (DENV), remain poorly understood. In this study, we identified 49 LRRP-coding genes in the Ae. On the basis of LRR copy number and sequence features, these LRRPs were classified into five subfamilies: “Long” LRRPs, “Short” LRRPs, “TM” LRRPs, “Coil-less” LRRPs and “F-box” LRRPs. Phylogenetic and functional domain analysis revealed that the LRRPs of Ae. albopictus were highly conserved relative to their orthologs in other mosquito species. Expression profiling indicated that the LRIM1 and APL1A/B/C orthologs in Ae. albopictus display distinct expression patterns across developmental stages and in adult tissues. Furthermore, both blood feeding and DENV infection significantly modulated the transcriptional profiles of Ae. Collectively, our study provides a foundation for systematically exploring the functions of LRRPs during mosquito development, blood feeding, and innate immunity.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to explore the roles of leucine-rich repeat proteins (LRRPs) in Aedes albopictus in response to dengue virus infection, as these proteins are critical for anti-Plasmodium immunity in other mosquitoes but their functions in dengue vectors remain poorly understood.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This study focused on Aedes albopictus, a major vector of dengue virus, and identified 49 LRRP-coding genes in this species. The research was conducted to examine the expression patterns of these genes across developmental stages and in adult tissues.
analysis.methods: The study used phylogenetic and functional domain analysis to classify the LRRPs into subfamilies based on LRR copy number and sequence features. Expression profiling was performed to assess the transcriptional profiles of these proteins in response to blood feeding and dengue virus infection.
analysis.main_results: The study identified 49 LRRP-coding genes in Aedes albopictus and classified them into five subfamilies. Phylogenetic and functional domain analysis revealed that these LRRPs are highly conserved relative to their orthologs in other mosquito species.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that LRRPs in Aedes albopictus are structurally conserved but may have distinct functional roles compared to other mosquitoes, providing a foundation for further research on their involvement in dengue virus infection.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results contribute to understanding the molecular mechanisms of mosquito immunity against dengue virus, which could inform future studies on vector biology and strategies for disease control.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on abstract-only evidence, and the findings are limited to gene identification and classification without detailed functional analysis or experimental validation. The evidence strength is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the roles of leucine-rich repeat proteins (LRRPs) in Aedes albopictus, a major vector of dengue virus, by identifying 49 LRRP-coding genes and classifying them into five subfamilies. The analysis revealed that these LRRPs are highly conserved relative to their orthologs in other mosquito species. The findings suggest that LRRPs in Aedes albopictus may have distinct functional roles compared to other mosquitoes, providing a foundation for further research on their involvement in dengue virus infection. The study's significance lies in its contribution to understanding mosquito immunity against dengue virus, which could inform future strategies for disease control. However, the study is based on abstract-only evidence, and the findings are limited to gene identification and classification without detailed functional analysis or experimental validation, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在探讨白纹伊蚊中富含亮氨酸的重复蛋白(LRRP)在响应 登革病毒 感染中的作用,因为这些蛋白对于其他蚊子的抗疟原虫免疫至关重要,但它们在登革热 媒介 中的功能仍知之甚少。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究重点关注白纹伊蚊(媒介 中的一种主要 媒介),并鉴定了该物种中的 49 个 LRRP 编码基因。该研究旨在检查这些基因在整个发育阶段和成人组织中的表达模式。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究使用系统发育和功能域分析,根据 LRR 拷贝数和序列特征将 LRRP 分类为亚科。进行表达谱分析以评估这些蛋白质响应血液喂养和 登革病毒 感染的转录谱。
elements_zh.main_results: 该研究在白纹伊蚊中鉴定出了 49 个 LRRP 编码基因,并将它们分为 5 个亚科。系统发育和功能域分析表明,这些 LRRP 相对于其他蚊子物种的直系同源物而言是高度保守的。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,白纹伊蚊中的 LRRP 在结构上是保守的,但与其他蚊子相比可能具有独特的功能作用,这为进一步研究它们参与 登革病毒 感染奠定了基础。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果有助于了解蚊子对 登革病毒 免疫的分子机制,这可以为未来 媒介 生物学和疾病控制策略的研究提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅基于抽象证据,研究结果仅限于基因识别和分类,没有详细的功能分析或实验验证。证据强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 蚊子传播多种人类病原体,包括疟原虫寄生虫和虫媒病毒。昆虫主要依靠模式识别受体(PRR)来启动针对入侵病原体的先天免疫。富含亮氨酸的重复蛋白 (LRRP),例如 LRIM1 和 APL1,是介导按蚊抗疟原虫免疫的关键 PRR。然而,这些蛋白质在白纹伊蚊(媒介 登革病毒 (DENV) 的主要 媒介)中的作用仍知之甚少。在这项研究中,我们鉴定了伊蚊中的 49 个 LRRP 编码基因。根据LRR拷贝数和序列特征,这些LRRP被分为五个亚家族:“长”LRRP、“短”LRRP、“TM”LRRP、“无线圈”LRRP和“F-box”LRRP。系统发育和功能域分析表明,Ae 的 LRRP。白纹伊蚊相对于其他蚊种的直系同源物而言高度保守。表达谱表明,AE 中的 LRIM1 和 APL1A/B/C 直向同源物。白纹伊蚊在整个发育阶段和成体组织中表现出不同的表达模式。此外,吸血和登革热病毒感染都显着调节了伊蚊的转录谱。总的来说,我们的研究为系统地探索 LRRP 在蚊子发育、吸血和先天免疫过程中的功能奠定了基础。

papers.title: A tunable immune-evasion function of Zika virus NS5 governs viral fitness and pathogenesis.
papers.abstract: Type I interferon (IFN) signaling is a central antiviral defense, with STAT2 driving the expression of IFN-stimulated genes (ISGs) to restrict viral infection. Zika virus (ZIKV) and dengue virus evade this pathway through nonstructural protein 5 (NS5)-mediated ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation of STAT2, yet the contribution of this immune-evasion strategy to viral fitness and pathogenesis remains incompletely defined. Here, using a multistep mutational scanning strategy that jointly assessed STAT2 degradation and viral RNA replication, we identified a single NS5 residue, L162, as uniquely permissive to substitution that abolishes STAT2 degradation without compromising intrinsic replication functions. Substitution of L162 with alanine or glycine (L162A or L162G) selectively disrupted NS5 recruitment of the ZSWIM8-CUL3 E3 ubiquitin ligase, thereby preserving STAT2 stability and restoring IFN signaling. Recombinant ZIKV carrying these mutations exhibited reduced replication and enhanced ISG induction in human cells, defects fully rescued by STAT2 knockout. In A129 mice (type I IFN receptor deficient), mutant and WT viruses replicated comparably, but in human STAT2 knock-in mice, ZIKV-NS5 L162G exhibited markedly reduced viral loads and disease. In pregnant human STAT2 knock-in mice, the mutant also reduced placental and fetal viral burdens and adverse pregnancy outcomes. Notably, infection with ZIKV-NS5 L162G elicited robust neutralizing antibody and T cell responses that conferred protection against WT challenge. Together, these findings establish NS5-mediated STAT2 degradation as a central determinant of ZIKV immune-evasion, viral fitness, and pathogenesis and highlight disruption of NS5–STAT2 antagonism as a promising strategy for antiviral intervention and rational attenuation.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate how ZIKV evades the immune system and how this affects its ability to replicate and cause disease. analysis.methods: The researchers employed a multistep mutational scanning strategy that jointly assessed STAT2 degradation and viral RNA replication. They substituted a single NS5 residue, L162, with alanine or glycine and evaluated the effects on viral replication and immune signaling.

analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate that NS5-mediated STAT2 degradation is a central mechanism for ZIKV immune evasion, viral fitness, and pathogenesis. In mice models, the mutant virus exhibited lower viral loads and disease severity compared to wild-type ZIKV. These findings establish NS5-mediated STAT2 degradation as a central determinant of ZIKV immune evasion and suggest that targeting this interaction could be a promising strategy for antiviral intervention. However, the study is limited to in vitro and in vivo models, and the evidence is based on abstract-only data.

papers.abstract_zh: I 型干扰素 (IFN) 信号传导是 抗病毒药物 防御的核心,STAT2 驱动 IFN 刺激基因 (ISG) 的表达以限制病毒感染。寨卡病毒 (ZIKV) 和 登革病毒 通过非结构蛋白 5 (NS5) 介导的 STAT2 泛素化和蛋白酶体降解来逃避这一途径,但这种免疫逃避策略对病毒适应性和 发病机制 的贡献仍未完全确定。在这里,使用联合评估 STAT2 降解和病毒 RNA 复制的多步突变扫描策略,我们确定了一个 NS5 残基 L162,它唯一允许取代,从而消除 STAT2 降解而不损害内在的复制功能。用丙氨酸或甘氨酸(L162A 或 L162G)替代 L162 选择性破坏 ZSWIM8-CUL3 E3 泛素连接酶的 NS5 募集,从而保持 STAT2 稳定性并恢复 IFN 信号传导。携带这些 突变 的重组 ZIKV 在人类细胞中表现出复制减少和 ISG 诱导增强,这些缺陷可通过 STAT2 敲除完全修复。在 A129 小鼠(I 型 IFN 受体缺陷)中,突变病毒和 WT 病毒的复制情况相当,但在人 STAT2 敲入小鼠中,ZIKV-NS5 L162G 表现出病毒载量和疾病显着减少。在怀孕的人类 STAT2 敲入小鼠中,该突变体还减少了胎盘和胎儿的病毒负荷以及不良妊娠结局。值得注意的是,ZIKV-NS5 L162G 的感染引发了强大的中和抗体和 T 细胞反应,从而提供了针对 WT 攻击的保护。总之,这些发现证实 NS5 介导的 STAT2 降解是 ZIKV 免疫逃避、病毒适应度和 发病机制 的核心决定因素,并强调破坏 NS5-STAT2 拮抗作用是 抗病毒药物 干预和合理减弱的有前途的策略。

papers.title: IgM monoclonal antibodies reduce IgG-mediated antibody-dependent enhancement of Zika and dengue virus infectivity
papers.abstract: Zika virus (ZIKV) is an arthropod-borne flavivirus endemic to Latin America, Africa, and Southeast Asia for which IgG-mediated antibody-dependent enhancement of infectivity (ADE) is a phenomenon of concern. The dynamics between flavivirus-specific antibodies of the IgG and IgM isotypes are mostly unknown. Here, we used DH1017.IgM, a previously described human-derived, pentameric, ultrapotent neutralizing ZIKV IgM monoclonal antibody (mAb) and a recombinantly produced IgM version of neutralizing EDE1 mAb C8 (C8.IgM) to assess if IgM antibodies can interfere with IgG-mediated ADE in vitro . Both mAbs consistently reduced IgG-mediated ADE across a panel of ZIKV-binding IgG mAbs in a dose-dependent manner. ADE mitigation was achieved at DH1017.IgM sub-neutralizing concentrations. C8.IgM also mitigated IgG-mediated ADE for ZIKV and dengue virus (DENV), demonstrating generalizability. Finally, DH1017.IgM confirmed inhibition of ADE at sub-neutralizing concentrations in sera of ZIKV-infected individuals. In conclusion, mAbs of the IgM isotype may potently counter the adverse effects of IgG-mediated ADE.

papers.title: Spatial-temporal clustering and high-risk area identification of dengue in Thailand: a 20-year national analysis using space-time scan statistics
papers.abstract: Abstract Dengue remains a major public health challenge in Thailand, with substantial geographic variation. This study analyzed national dengue surveillance data (2005–2024; 1,640,368 cases) across five consecutive 4-year intervals to identify spatial clustering patterns, detect space-time clusters, and characterize the evolution of high-risk areas. Province-level pooled incidence rates were assessed using Global Moran’s I, Local Indicators of Spatial Association (LISA), and SaTScan space-time scan statistics with discrete Poisson models. Global Moran’s I showed significant positive spatial autocorrelation in four periods (I = 0.211–0.473, p < 0.01) but not during 2017–2020 (I = 0.065, p = 0.190), indicating spatial fragmentation. LISA revealed a progressive decline in High-High cluster provinces from 11 to 2 and a geographic shift from Central-Eastern to Northern Thailand. SaTScan detected 13 statistically significant clusters; the most likely cluster occurred in Northern Thailand (2013–2016, relative risk = 2.33, p < 0.001). The cluster with the highest cumulative burden encompassed the Central-Western region (2009–2016, 149,010 cases). Dengue exhibits dynamically evolving geographic patterns, with Northern Thailand emerging as the primary high-risk area requiring priority intervention. These findings support geographically stratified control strategies.

source_records.title: Spatial-temporal clustering and high-risk area identification of dengue in Thailand: a 20-year national analysis using space-time scan statistics
source_records.abstract: Abstract Dengue remains a major public health challenge in Thailand, with substantial geographic variation. This study analyzed national dengue surveillance data (2005–2024; 1,640,368 cases) across five consecutive 4-year intervals to identify spatial clustering patterns, detect space-time clusters, and characterize the evolution of high-risk areas. Province-level pooled incidence rates were assessed using Global Moran’s I, Local Indicators of Spatial Association (LISA), and SaTScan space-time scan statistics with discrete Poisson models. Global Moran’s I showed significant positive spatial autocorrelation in four periods (I = 0.211–0.473, p < 0.01) but not during 2017–2020 (I = 0.065, p = 0.190), indicating spatial fragmentation. LISA revealed a progressive decline in High-High cluster provinces from 11 to 2 and a geographic shift from Central-Eastern to Northern Thailand. SaTScan detected 13 statistically significant clusters; the most likely cluster occurred in Northern Thailand (2013–2016, relative risk = 2.33, p < 0.001). The cluster with the highest cumulative burden encompassed the Central-Western region (2009–2016, 149,010 cases). Dengue exhibits dynamically evolving geographic patterns, with Northern Thailand emerging as the primary high-risk area requiring priority intervention. These findings support geographically stratified control strategies.

papers.title: Compound climate extremes predict dengue risk at operational lead times across Brazil
papers.abstract: Brazil has one of the highest dengue burdens globally, with transmission influenced by climate events. Yet, the effects of compound climate extremes on dengue risk and prediction have not been quantified to date. Using a Bayesian spatiotemporal model of monthly dengue cases across 435 health regions from 2010 to 2025, we estimated relative risk associated with interacting long-lag and short-lag drought indicators and temperature anomalies across nine Köppen-Geiger climatic zones, adjusting for absolute temperature and El Niño-Southern Oscillation. Long-lag dry, mid-lag warm and short-lag wet conditions were associated with the highest relative risk in five climatic zones, with temperature anomalies modifying hydrometeorological dynamics more strongly in temperate than tropical areas. Climate covariates improved the prediction of case counts and outbreaks compared to baseline models at lead times of 1, 3, 6 and 12 months, and for the upcoming season 5 months ahead. Improvements were greatest in the Northeast, Southeast, and Midwest. Recent dengue incidence provided the greatest improvement at the 1-month lead, whereas combining incidence with climate information performed best at 3- and 6-month leads. We extended our framework to weekly state-level predictions of the season ahead to align with national public health planning. We proposed a multi-staged dengue forecasting approach to enhance early warning and response across Brazil.

Yet, the effects of compound climate extremes on dengue risk and prediction have not been quantified to date. Using a Bayesian spatiotemporal model of monthly dengue cases across 435 health regions from 2010 to 2025, we estimated relative risk associated with interacting long-lag and short-lag drought indicators and temperature anomalies across nine Köppen-Geiger climatic zones, adjusting for absolute temperature and El Niño-Southern Oscillation. Long-lag dry, mid-lag warm and short-lag wet conditions were associated with the highest relative risk in five climatic zones, with temperature anomalies modifying hydrometeorological dynamics more strongly in temperate than tropical areas. Climate covariates improved the prediction of case counts and outbreaks compared to baseline models at lead times of 1, 3, 6 and 12 months, and for the upcoming season 5 months ahead. Improvements were greatest in the Northeast, Southeast, and Midwest. Recent dengue incidence provided the greatest improvement at the 1-month lead, whereas combining incidence with climate information performed best at 3- and 6-month leads. We extended our framework to weekly state-level predictions of the season ahead to align with national public health planning. We proposed a multi-staged dengue forecasting approach to enhance early warning and response across Brazil.
