papers.abstract_zh: 巴西是全球登革热负担最高的国家之一,传播 受到气候事件的影响。然而,复合极端气候对登革热风险和预测的影响迄今为止尚未量化。利用 2010 年至 2025 年 435 个卫生区域每月登革热病例的贝叶斯时空模型,我们估计了九个柯本-盖革气候区的长滞后和短滞后干旱指标与温度异常相互作用的相对风险,并根据绝对温度和厄尔尼诺南方涛动进行了调整。长滞后干燥、中滞后温暖和短滞后潮湿条件与五个气候区的最高相对风险相关,温带地区的温度异常比热带地区对水文气象动态的影响更大。与提前期为 1、3、6 和 12 个月以及提前 5 个月即将到来的季节的基线模型相比,气候协变量改进了对病例数和 暴发 的预测。东北部、东南部和中西部地区的改善最为明显。最近的登革热 发病率 在 1 个月领先时提供了最大的改善,而将 发病率 与气候信息相结合在 3 个月和 6 个月领先时表现最佳。我们将框架扩展到对未来季节的每周州级预测,以与国家公共卫生规划保持一致。我们提出了多阶段登革热预报方法,以加强巴西各地的早期预警和应对。

papers.title: Impact of urban heat islands on dengue thermal transmission suitability across contrasting U.S. cities
papers.abstract: Ectotherms such as mosquitoes are exquisitely sensitive to environmental conditions, including temperature. Dengue fever, caused by dengue virus and transmitted by Aedes mosquitos, is commonly thought of as a tropical disease but has recently emerged in small local outbreaks in the USA. Urban heat island effects are a well-known phenomenon, but measuring their impact on air temperature at the scale of urban environments is complicated by the limitations of meteorological observations. These observations are collected only at discrete coordinates in which weather stations are located, making it difficult to interpret spatial variation across a landscape. Although global gridded reanalysis data such as ERA5 are available at hourly frequency, the finest spatial resolution is 0.25 ∘ , and thus the details in variation are lost. In this project, we developed a framework for localized machine learning models to predict the air temperature at a fine-scale 30 meter resolution for a given study area. The models we present are trained on location-specific satellite imagery and local weather station data, but we provide automated code for use with freely available data, allowing them to be retrained for nearly any location. In this study, we used these predictions to assess the seasonality of dengue thermal transmission suitability for Aedes aegypti and Ae. albopictus in two US cities. Urbanized areas were associated with extended projected dengue seasons for both vector species. This highlights the need for attention to urban planning and vector control in order to reduce the burden of arboviruses in dense urban areas.

papers.abstract_zh: 蚊子等变温动物对环境条件(包括温度)非常敏感。登革热 是由 登革病毒 引起并由伊蚊传播的疾病,通常被认为是一种热带疾病,但最近在美国的小型局部 暴发 中出现。城市热岛效应是一种众所周知的现象,但由于气象观测的局限性,在城市环境范围内测量其对气温的影响变得复杂。这些观测结果仅在气象站所在的离散坐标处收集,因此很难解释整个景观的空间变化。尽管ERA5等全球网格化再分析数据可以每小时一次获得,但最精细的空间分辨率为0.25∘,因此丢失了变化的细节。在这个项目中,我们开发了一个本地化机器学习模型框架,能够以 30 米的精细分辨率预测给定研究区域的气温。我们提供的模型是根据特定位置的卫星图像和当地气象站数据进行训练的,但我们提供了与免费可用数据一起使用的自动化代码,使它们可以针对几乎任何位置进行重新训练。在本研究中,我们使用这些预测来评估登革热 传播 对埃及伊蚊和伊蚊的适宜性的季节性。白纹伊蚊分布在美国两个城市。城市化地区与 媒介 物种的预计登革热季节延长有关。这凸显了需要关注城市规划和 媒介 控制,以减轻密集城市地区虫媒病毒的负担。

papers.title: Faktor-Faktor yang Berhubungan dengan Kejadian Demam Berdarah Dengue di Wilayah Kerja Puskesmas Ulee Kareng Kota Banda Aceh
papers.abstract: Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DHF) remains a major public health challenge in tropical regions. Ulee Kareng Health Center recorded the highest number of DHF cases in Banda Aceh City, with a persistent surge reaching 49 cases in 2025. While prior studies evaluated environmental or behavioral factors in isolation, comprehensive evidence integrating domestic physical infrastructure and preventive behavior under individual matching designs remains limited. A quantitative observational study with a 1:1 matched case-control design was conducted from July 12–19, 2026. A total of 50 respondents (25 cases and 25 controls) were selected using total sampling for confirmed cases and neighborhood-matched controls based on age (±2 years) and sex. Bivariate relationships were evaluated using Chi-Square tests with Continuity Correction and Fisher's Exact Test to accommodate zero-cell counts in contingency tables. Significant associations were observed between DHF incidence and residential drainage condition (p=0.001), household waste management (p=0.001), and individual preventive actions (p=0.001; OR=3.778; 95% CI: 2.157–6.615). Conversely, clean water availability showed a borderline statistical value (p=0.050), which did not meet the strict statistical significance threshold (p<0.05). Conclusion: Inadequate home drainage, unsatisfactory waste management, and poor preventive actions significantly increase DHF transmission risk. Vector control interventions in Ulee Kareng must prioritize environmental sanitation and targeted community-based breeding site elimination (PSN 3M Plus).
papers.journal: Journal of Educational Innovation and Public Health

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to identify factors associated with dengue hemorrhagic fever (DHF) in Banda Aceh City, addressing the need to understand how environmental and behavioral factors contribute to DHF outbreaks in tropical regions.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A quantitative observational study with a 1:1 matched case-control design was conducted from July 12–19, 2026, at Ulee Kareng Health Center, which recorded the highest number of DHF cases in Banda Aceh City, reaching 49 cases in 2025. A total of 50 respondents (25 cases and 25 controls) were selected using total sampling for confirmed cases and neighborhood-matched controls based on age (±2 years) and sex.
analysis.methods: Bivariate relationships were evaluated using Chi-Square tests with Continuity Correction and Fisher's Exact Test to accommodate zero-cell counts in contingency tables. The study focused on assessing residential drainage conditions, household waste management, and individual preventive actions.
analysis.main_results: Significant associations were observed between DHF incidence and residential drainage condition (p=0.001), household waste management (p=0.001), and individual preventive actions (p=0.001; OR=3.778; 95% CI: 2.157–6.615). Clean water availability showed a borderline statistical value (p=0.050), which did not meet the strict statistical significance threshold (p<0.05).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that inadequate home drainage, unsatisfactory waste management, and poor preventive actions significantly increase DHF transmission risk. This study provides novel insights by integrating domestic physical infrastructure and preventive behavior under individual matching designs.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform targeted vector control interventions in Ulee Kareng, emphasizing the importance of environmental sanitation and community-based breeding site elimination (PSN 3M Plus) to reduce DHF transmission risk.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a single health center in Banda Aceh City, which may affect generalisability. The evidence strength is moderate due to the observational design and the small sample size.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated factors associated with dengue hemorrhagic fever (DHF) in Banda Aceh City, focusing on environmental and behavioral determinants. Conducted as a 1:1 matched case-control study from July 12–19, 2026, it included 25 DHF cases and 25 neighborhood-matched controls. The results showed significant associations between DHF incidence and residential drainage conditions, household waste management, and individual preventive actions. Clean water availability had a borderline statistical value. The authors concluded that poor drainage, waste management, and preventive behaviors increase DHF transmission risk. The study highlights the need for environmental sanitation and community-based interventions to mitigate DHF. However, the findings are limited to a single health center and have moderate evidence strength due to the observational design and small sample size.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2026 年 7 月 12 日至 19 日,在 Ulee Kareng 健康中心进行了一项采用 1:1 匹配病例对照设计的定量观察研究,该中心记录了班达亚齐市 DHF 病例数量最多,到 2025 年达到 49 例。使用确诊病例总抽样和基于年龄(±2 岁)和性别的社区匹配对照,总共选择了 50 名受访者(25 例病例和 25 名对照)。

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,家庭排水不足、废物管理不善和预防措施不力会显着增加 DHF 传播 风险。这项研究通过在个人匹配设计下整合国内物理基础设施和预防行为,提供了新颖的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可为 Ulee Kareng 的针对性 媒介 控制干预措施提供信息,强调环境卫生和社区繁殖地消除 (PSN 3M Plus) 对于降低 DHF 传播 风险的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于班达亚齐市的一个卫生中心,这可能会影响普遍性。由于观察设计和小样本量,证据强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 登革出血热 (DHF) 仍然是热带地区的一项重大公共卫生挑战。Ulee Kareng 健康中心记录了班达亚齐市 DHF 病例数量最多,持续激增,到 2025 年达到 49 例。虽然之前的研究单独评估了环境或行为因素,但在个人匹配设计下整合国内物理基础设施和预防行为的综合证据仍然有限。2026 年 7 月 12 日至 19 日进行了一项采用 1:1 匹配病例对照设计的定量观察研究。根据年龄(±2 岁)和性别,对确诊病例和邻里匹配对照进行总抽样,共选择了 50 名受访者(25 名病例和 25 名对照)。使用带有连续性校正的卡方检验和费舍尔精确检验来评估双变量关系,以适应列联表中的零单元格计数。DHF 发病率 与住宅排水条件 (p=0.001)、家庭废物管理 (p=0.001) 和个人预防措施 (p=0.001;OR=3.778;95% CI: 2.157–6.615) 之间存在显着相关性。相反,清洁水的可用性显示出临界统计值(p=0.050),未达到严格的统计显着性阈值(p<0.05)。结论:家庭排水不充分、废物管理不理想以及预防措施不力会显着增加 DHF 传播 风险。Ulee Kareng 的 媒介 控制干预措施必须优先考虑环境卫生和有针对性的社区繁殖地消除 (PSN 3M Plus)。

papers.title: Stationary distribution and ergodicity of an SEIR stochastic dengue epidemic model
papers.abstract: The paper proposes an SEIR dengue epidemic model with a saturated incidence rate and establishes the corresponding stochastic model. The dynamical behavior of the stochastic system is investigated, which includes the existence and uniqueness of a global positive solution, the existence and uniqueness of an ergodic stationary distribution, and the sufficient conditions for extinction of the disease. Finally, numerical simulations are conducted to illustrate and support the effectiveness of certain theoretical results.

papers.title: Activated Partial Thromboplastin Time (aPTT) as a Predictor of Bleeding Manifestations and Severity in Adult Patients with Dengue – A Cross Sectional Study
papers.abstract: Background: Dengue fever is a leading cause of acute febrile illness in tropical regions. Thrombocytopenia alone correlates poorly with bleeding in dengue. Activated partial thromboplastin time (aPTT) reflects intrinsic coagulation dysfunction and may serve as a superior predictor. Objectives: To assess deranged aPTT as a predictor of bleeding manifestations and to evaluate its association with severity of dengue in adult patients. Methods: Cross-sectional observational study at SVMCH & RC, Puducherry (January–March 2026). Forty adult patients with serologically confirmed dengue were enrolled. aPTT at admission was the primary exposure variable; patients were observed for bleeding and severe dengue (CDC 2015 criteria). Results: Twenty of the forty patients exhibited prolonged aPTT (mean 54.8 ± 9.3 s) and twenty had normal aPTT (mean 34.6 ± 2.9 s). Any bleeding (RR=3.25; p=0.026), substantial bleeding (RR=3.00; p=0.048), and severe dengue (RR=3.75; p=0.001) were all strongly correlated with prolonged aPTT. For significant bleeding, the negative predictive value (NPV) was 95.0%. There was no discernible relationship between platelet count and bleeding symptoms. Conclusion: aPTT is a reliable rule-out screening tool for major bleeding and severity in dengue, with an NPV of 95%. Platelet count alone is insufficient to predict bleeding risk.

papers.title: Nanotechnology-Enabled Vaccines for Malaria, Tuberculosis, HIV, and Dengue: Translational Evidence and Implementation in the Global South
papers.abstract: Nanoscale materials can support vaccine delivery, antigen display and immune stimulation, but successful platform function or enhanced immunogenicity does not necessarily establish meaningful or durable clinical protection. This narrative review examines evidence published from January 2016 through April 2026, with selected foundational studies, for nanotechnology-enabled vaccines against malaria, tuberculosis, human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) and dengue, focusing on their relevance to the Global South. These diseases were selected for their substantial public-health burden, distinct biological barriers to vaccination and contrasting stages of translational development, enabling comparison across preclinical research, human immunogenicity, clinical efficacy and implementation evidence. The synthesis distinguishes the functional contribution of nanoscale carriers, antigen-display scaffolds and adjuvants from the performance of complete vaccine formulations. Malaria has the most advanced clinical and implementation evidence among the reviewed platforms. Tuberculosis has disease-prevention evidence in a defined infected adult population, and HIV and dengue platforms remain predominantly at preclinical or early clinical stages. Clinical efficacy of a nano-enabled formulation does not, by itself, quantify the incremental benefit attributable to its nanoscale component. Across diseases, translational value depends on antigen suitability, disease-relevant immune function, durability, formulation-specific safety and applicability to the intended population. Evidence from selected trial cohorts cannot automatically be generalized across heterogeneous Global South settings. Manufacturing readiness, storage requirements, affordable complete schedules, regulatory capacity and equitable access must therefore be assessed alongside biological performance. The review identifies where links between platform function, clinical benefit and feasible implementation are supported and where they remain unestablished.

analysis.scope_and_question: This review focuses on nanotechnology-enabled vaccines for dengue virus, specifically examining their translational evidence and implementation potential in the Global South. The central question is whether these vaccines can provide meaningful and durable clinical protection against dengue, considering the unique biological and public health challenges associated with the disease.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis of evidence published from January 2016 through April 2026, with selected foundational studies. It does not report on meta-analysis or pooled estimates but instead provides a qualitative overview of the evidence, emphasizing the functional contributions of nanoscale carriers, antigen-display scaffolds, and adjuvants in vaccine formulations.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that dengue has the most advanced clinical and implementation evidence among the reviewed platforms. It highlights that the clinical efficacy of a nano-enabled formulation does not automatically quantify the incremental benefit from its nanoscale component, and that translational value depends on factors such as antigen suitability, immune function, durability, and formulation-specific safety.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: There is evidence that the performance of complete vaccine formulations cannot be solely attributed to their nanoscale components. Additionally, the review notes that evidence from selected trial cohorts may not be generalizable across all Global South settings due to heterogeneity. The review also identifies gaps in understanding the links between platform function, clinical benefit, and feasible implementation.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review emphasizes the need to assess manufacturing readiness, storage requirements, affordable complete schedules, regulatory capacity, and equitable access alongside biological performance. It also suggests that further research is required to establish the incremental benefits of nanoscale components in vaccine formulations and to improve generalizability across diverse populations in the Global South.

analysis.summary_en: This review evaluates nanotechnology-enabled vaccines for dengue virus, focusing on their translational potential and implementation in the Global South. It highlights that while dengue has the most advanced clinical evidence, the incremental benefit of nanoscale components remains unclear. The review underscores the importance of assessing factors such as antigen suitability, immune function, and formulation-specific safety. It also identifies gaps in generalizability across diverse populations and calls for further research to improve vaccine performance and accessibility.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述重点关注纳米技术支持的 疫苗 for 登革病毒,特别检查其在全球南方的转化证据和实施潜力。核心问题是,考虑到与该疾病相关的独特的生物学和公共卫生挑战,这些 疫苗 是否能够提供有意义且持久的针对登革热的临床保护。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该评论是对 2016 年 1 月至 2026 年 4 月期间发表的证据的叙述性综合,其中包括选定的基础研究。它不报告荟萃分析或汇总估计,而是提供证据的定性概述,强调 疫苗 制剂中纳米级载体、抗原展示支架和佐剂的功能贡献。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 审查得出的结论是,登革热在审查的平台中拥有最先进的临床和实施证据。它强调,纳米制剂的临床功效不会自动量化其纳米级成分的增量益处,并且转化价值取决于抗原适用性、免疫功能、耐久性和制剂特定安全性等因素。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 有证据表明,完整的 疫苗 配方的性能不能仅仅归因于其纳米级成分。此外,审查指出,由于异质性,选定试验 队列研究 的证据可能无法推广到所有南半球国家。该审查还确定了在理解平台功能、临床效益和可行实施之间的联系方面的差距。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该审查强调需要评估生产准备情况、存储要求、负担得起的完整时间表、监管能力以及公平获取和生物性能。它还表明需要进一步研究来确定 疫苗 配方中纳米级成分的增量效益,并提高全球南方不同人群的普遍适用性。

papers.abstract_zh: 纳米级材料可以支持 疫苗 递送、抗原展示和免疫刺激,但成功的平台功能或增强的免疫原性并不一定能建立有意义或持久的临床保护。这篇叙述性综述审查了 2016 年 1 月至 2026 年 4 月发表的证据,以及选定的基础研究,用于纳米技术支持的 疫苗 对抗疟疾、结核病、人类免疫缺陷病毒 (HIV) 和登革热,重点关注它们与全球南方的相关性。选择这些疾病是因为其巨大的公共卫生负担、疫苗接种 的独特生物障碍以及转化发展的对比阶段,从而能够在临床前研究、人类免疫原性、临床疗效和实施证据之间进行比较。该合成将纳米级载体、抗原展示支架和佐剂的功能贡献与完整 疫苗 制剂的性能区分开来。Malaria 在已审查的平台中拥有最先进的临床和实施证据。结核病在确定的感染成年人群中具有疾病预防证据,而艾滋病毒和登革热平台仍主要处于临床前或早期临床阶段。纳米制剂的临床功效本身并不能量化归因于其纳米级成分的增量益处。在疾病中,转化价值取决于抗原的适用性、疾病相关的免疫功能、耐久性、制剂特异性的安全性以及对目标人群的适用性。来自选定试验 队列研究 的证据不能自动推广到异构的全球南方环境中。因此,必须与生物性能一起评估生产准备情况、储存要求、负担得起的完整时间表、监管能力和公平获取。该审查确定了平台功能、临床效益和可行实施之间的联系在哪些方面得到了支持,哪些方面尚未建立。

papers.title: Dengue Fever Prevention Education For Communities At Mangkupalas Health Center
papers.abstract: Dengue remains a significant public health challenge within the operational area of Puskesmas Mangkupalas, while the baseline knowledge of community members regarding its prevention remains inadequate. This community service activity aims to enhance public awareness concerning vector control through mosquito nest eradication via draining, covering, recycling used items, and supplementary preventive measures. The educational program was conducted on May 23, 2026, engaging 20 participants through interactive lectures, discussions, question-and-answer sessions, and leaflets. Knowledge levels were assessed using a 10-item questionnaire administered before and immediately after the intervention. The average score increased from 6,40 to 9,45. Participants classified under the good knowledge category rose from 4 individuals (20%) to 18 individuals (90%), whereas those in the poor category decreased from 16 individuals (80%) to 2 individuals (10%). The Wilcoxon signed-rank test confirmed a significant difference in scores before and after the education session (Z = -3,871; p = 0,001). These findings indicate a short-term improvement in knowledge following the educational intervention, while continued monitoring remains necessary to evaluate the practical application of preventive behaviors within households

papers.title: Travel Health Preparation Booklet on Malaria and Dengue for International Students Visiting Endemic Regions
papers.abstract: This booklet is an educational travel health resource developed for international students traveling to malaria- and dengue-endemic regions, with Indonesia as the primary context. It provides information on disease characteristics, transmission, symptoms, diagnosis, prevention, treatment, vaccines, mosquito-bite prevention, and practical travel preparation. The booklet underwent expert content validation and target-user evaluation. It is intended as a supplementary educational resource and does not replace professional medical advice or individualized pre-travel consultation.

papers.title: Bukti Terkini Pencegahan dan Penatalaksanaan Dengue pada Pasien Dewasa
papers.abstract: Infeksi virus dengue (DENV) merupakan arbovirosis dengan laju penyebaran tercepat di dunia dan beban yang terus meningkat di Indonesia. Tahun 2024 tercatat sebagai tahun dengan jumlah kasus tertinggi yang pernah dilaporkan kepada Badan Kesehatan Dunia (WHO), dan Indonesia menempati posisi kedua terbesar di dunia. Dalam dua tahun terakhir, lanskap tata laksana dan pencegahan dengue berubah secara substansial: WHO menerbitkan pedoman klinis berbasis GRADE untuk penyakit arboviral pada Juli 2025, vaksin tetravalen TAK-003 memperoleh rekomendasi WHO dan data efektivitas dunia nyata pertamanya, vaksin dosis tunggal Butantan-DV melaporkan hasil fase 3, sementara kandidat antivirus spesifik pertama memasuki dan sebagian dihentikan pada uji klinis fase 2. Tinjauan pustaka ini merangkum bukti terkini mengenai epidemiologi, patogenesis, diagnosis, pencegahan, dan penatalaksanaan infeksi dengue dengan penekanan pada pasien dewasa serta konteks endemis Indonesia. Diagnosis awal berfokus pada pemilihan pemeriksaan yang sesuai dengan hari sakit; meta-analisis terbaru menunjukkan sensitivitas enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) antigen nonstruktural 1 (NS1) sebanding dengan reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) pada fase awal. Pencegahan bergeser dari pengendalian vektor berbasis insektisida, yang efektivitasnya menurun karena terjadinya resistensi, menuju pendekatan biologis Wolbachia dan vaksinasi. Penatalaksanaan tetap bersifat suportif dengan terapi utama yaitu resusitasi cairan kristaloid; WHO 2025 secara eksplisit menyarankan tidak menggunakan kortikosteroid sistemik maupun transfusi trombosit profilaksis, dan merekomendasikan kadar laktat serta waktu pengisian kapiler sebagai pemandu terapi cairan. Keterbatasan saat ini adalah ketiadaan terapi antivirus spesifik, keterbatasan data efikasi vaksin terhadap serotipe DENV-3 dan DENV-4 pada individu seronegatif, serta minimnya uji acak terkendali pada populasi dewasa.
authors: I Gusti Sri Agung Jaya Kusumadewi

papers.abstract_original: Infeksi virus dengue (DENV) merupakan arbovirosis dengan laju penyebaran tercepat di dunia dan beban yang terus meningkat di Indonesia. Tahun 2024 tercatat sebagai tahun dengan jumlah kasus tertinggi yang pernah dilaporkan kepada Badan Kesehatan Dunia (WHO), dan Indonesia menempati posisi kedua terbesar di dunia. Dalam dua tahun terakhir, lanskap tata laksana dan pencegahan dengue berubah secara substansial: WHO menerbitkan pedoman klinis berbasis GRADE untuk penyakit arboviral pada Juli 2025, vaksin tetravalen TAK-003 memperoleh rekomendasi WHO dan data efektivitas dunia nyata pertamanya, vaksin dosis tunggal Butantan-DV melaporkan hasil fase 3, sementara kandidat antivirus spesifik pertama memasuki dan sebagian dihentikan pada uji klinis fase 2. Tinjauan pustaka ini merangkum bukti terkini mengenai epidemiologi, patogenesis, diagnosis, pencegahan, dan penatalaksanaan infeksi dengue dengan penekanan pada pasien dewasa serta konteks endemis Indonesia. Diagnosis awal berfokus pada pemilihan pemeriksaan yang sesuai dengan hari sakit; meta-analisis terbaru menunjukkan sensitivitas enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) antigen nonstruktural 1 (NS1) sebanding dengan reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) pada fase awal. Pencegahan bergeser dari pengendalian vektor berbasis insektisida, yang efektivitasnya menurun karena terjadinya resistensi, menuju pendekatan biologis Wolbachia dan vaksinasi. Penatalaksanaan tetap bersifat suportif dengan terapi utama yaitu resusitasi cairan kristaloid; WHO 2025 secara eksplisit menyarankan tidak menggunakan kortikosteroid sistemik maupun transfusi trombosit profilaksis, dan merekomendasikan kadar laktat serta waktu pengisian kapiler sebagai pemandu terapi cairan. Keterbatasan saat ini adalah ketiadaan terapi antivirus spesifik, keterbatasan data efikasi vaksin terhadap serotipe DENV-3 dan DENV-4 pada individu seronegatif, serta minimnya uji acak terkendali pada populasi dewasa.

analysis.summary_en: This study provides an updated review of the epidemiology, pathogenesis, diagnosis, prevention, and management of dengue infection, with a focus on adult patients in an endemic context. It highlights the shift from insecticide-based vector control to biological approaches like Wolbachia and vaccination, emphasizing the need for improved antiviral therapies and more controlled trials. The review underscores the importance of early diagnosis using NS1 ELISA and RT-PCR, and outlines the current limitations in treatment and vaccine efficacy, particularly against DENV-3 and DENV-4. The findings suggest that supportive care, including fluid resuscitation guided by lactate levels and capillary refill time, remains the mainstay of management. The study contributes to the understanding of dengue in Indonesia and informs future research directions.

papers.title: Impacto epidemiológico del dengue y del chikungunya en zonas urbanas: revisión sistemática Epidemiological impact of dengue and chikungunya in urban areas: a systematic review
papers.abstract: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre el impacto epidemiológico urbano del dengue y del chikungunya. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios. Resultados: la incidencia mundial del dengue aumentó desde 1990, con diferencias regionales marcadas y alta carga en América Latina. El chikungunya se expandió por las Américas desde 2013 y produjo brotes urbanos explosivos, con manifestaciones articulares persistentes. La urbanización, la expansión de Aedes aegypti y Aedes albopictus y la resistencia a insecticidas favorecieron la transmisión. Destacan como estrategias las nuevas vacunas y el control vectorial integrado. Conclusión: ambas arbovirosis son una carga creciente para las ciudades tropicales y subtropicales y exigen vigilancia y control sostenidos.

Resultados: la incidencia mundial del dengue aumentó desde 1990, con diferencias regionales marcadas y alta carga en América Latina. El chikungunya se expandió por las Américas desde 2013 y produjo brotes urbanos explosivos, con manifestaciones articulares persistentes. La urbanización, la expansión de Aedes aegypti y Aedes albopictus y la resistencia a insecticidas favorecieron la transmisión. Destacan como estrategias las nuevas vacunas y el control vectorial integrado. Conclusión: ambas arbovirosis son una carga creciente para las ciudades tropicales y subtropicales y exigen vigilancia y control sostenidos.

analysis.scope_and_question: El objetivo de esta revisión sistemática fue sintetizar la evidencia sobre el impacto epidemiológico urbano del dengue y del chikungunya. La revisión abarca Dengue viruses 1–4 y la enfermedad dengue, excluyendo otros flaviviruses como Zika, fiebre amarilla, virus del Nilo Occidental y virus de la encefalitis japonesa, a menos que se presenten evidencias específicas sobre el dengue.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: La revisión sistemática se realizó en PubMed y SciELO entre 2012 y 2025, incluyendo 15 estudios. Se utilizó una síntesis narrativa para resumir la evidencia, sin realizar meta-análisis estadísticos.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Los resultados muestran que la incidencia mundial del dengue aumentó desde 1990, con diferencias regionales marcadas y una alta carga en América Latina. El chikungunya se expandió por las Américas desde 2013, causando brotes urbanos explosivos y manifestaciones articulares persistentes.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: La evidencia indica que la urbanización, la expansión de Aedes aegypti y Aedes albopictus, así como la resistencia a insecticidas, favorecen la transmisión de ambos virus. Sin embargo, no se reportan estudios que aborden de manera específica los mecanismos de transmisión o la variabilidad genética de los Dengue viruses 1–4 en contextos urbanos.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Se destacan como estrategias las nuevas vacunas y el control vectorial integrado para mitigar el impacto de la dengue. Se recomienda fortalecer la vigilancia epidemiológica y la implementación de medidas de control en áreas urbanas con alta prevalencia de los Dengue viruses 1–4.

analysis.summary_en: Esta revisión sistemática analiza el impacto epidemiológico urbano del dengue y del chikungunya, enfocándose en Dengue viruses 1–4 y la enfermedad dengue. Se incluyeron 15 estudios obtenidos de PubMed y SciELO entre 2012 y 2025. Los resultados muestran un aumento global en la incidencia del dengue desde 1990, con una carga significativa en América Latina, y una expansión del chikungunya en las Américas desde 2013, causando brotes explosivos. Se identificaron factores como la urbanización, la presencia de Aedes aegypti y Aedes albopictus, y la resistencia a insecticidas como promotores de la transmisión. Se destacan estrategias como las vacunas y el control vectorial integrado, y se recomienda una vigilancia epidemiológica más robusta en áreas urbanas afectadas.

papers.title: Unilateral dengue-associated neuroretinitis: a case report
papers.abstract: Abstract We report a rare case of unilateral neuroretinitis associated with dengue infection in a 33-year-old man presenting with acute visual loss in the right eye following a febrile illness acquired during travel to Thailand. Although ocular manifestations of dengue are well recognized, they are typically bilateral, making unilateral involvement uncommon. Ophthalmic examination revealed unilateral optic disc oedema, retinal thickening involving the macula, vitritis, and retinal haemorrhages. Optical coherence tomography demonstrated marked serous retinal detachment with significant central thickening, while fluorescein angiography confirmed optic disc and retinal vascular leakage consistent with neuroretinitis and retinal vasculitis in the affected eye. Extensive neurological and infectious work-up excluded alternative causes of neuroretinitis. Serological testing confirmed a pattern consistent with recent dengue infection. The patient was treated with systemic corticosteroids following exclusion of active phase of infection, resulting in rapid anatomical improvement and significant visual recovery, which remained stable at long-term follow-up. This case highlights that dengue-associated neuroretinitis may present unilaterally, and dengue infection should be considered in the differential diagnosis of posterior segment inflammation in returning travellers, even in atypical presentations.
papers.journal: Journal of Ophthalmic Inflammation and Infection

Ophthalmic examination revealed unilateral optic disc oedema, retinal thickening involving the macula, vitritis, and retinal haemorrhages. Optical coherence tomography demonstrated marked serous retinal detachment with significant central thickening, while fluorescein angiography confirmed optic disc and retinal vascular leakage consistent with neuroretinitis and retinal vasculitis in the affected eye. Extensive neurological and infectious work-up excluded alternative causes of neuroretinitis. Serological testing confirmed a pattern consistent with recent dengue infection. The patient was treated with systemic corticosteroids following exclusion of active phase of infection, resulting in rapid anatomical improvement and significant visual recovery, which remained stable at long-term follow-up. This case highlights that dengue-associated neuroretinitis may present unilaterally, and dengue infection should be considered in the differential diagnosis of posterior segment inflammation in returning travellers, even in atypical presentations.
source_records.journal: Journal of Ophthalmic Inflammation and Infection

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to report a rare case of unilateral neuroretinitis associated with dengue infection, highlighting the need to consider dengue as a potential cause of atypical ocular inflammation in returning travelers.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A case report was conducted on a 33-year-old man who developed acute visual loss in the right eye following a febrile illness acquired during travel to Thailand.
analysis.methods: The patient underwent ophthalmic examination, optical coherence tomography, and fluorescein angiography to assess retinal changes. Serological testing was performed to confirm dengue infection, and extensive neurological and infectious work-up was conducted to exclude alternative causes.
analysis.main_results: Ophthalmic examination revealed unilateral optic disc oedema, retinal thickening involving the macula, vitritis, and retinal haemorrhages. Optical coherence tomography demonstrated marked serous retinal detachment with significant central thickening, while fluorescein angiography confirmed optic disc and retinal vascular leakage consistent with neuroretinitis and retinal vasculitis in the affected eye.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that dengue-associated neuroretinitis can present unilaterally, which is uncommon, and emphasize the importance of considering dengue infection in the differential diagnosis of posterior segment inflammation in returning travelers.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: This case underscores the need for vigilance in diagnosing dengue-related ocular complications, particularly in travelers returning from endemic regions, and highlights the potential for atypical presentations that may require specific diagnostic approaches.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a single case report, which may not be generalizable. However, the evidence is strong as it includes detailed clinical and diagnostic findings, and the patient's condition was confirmed through serological testing and imaging.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes a rare instance of unilateral dengue-associated neuroretinitis in a 33-year-old man who experienced acute visual loss following a febrile illness during travel to Thailand. Ophthalmic examination and imaging revealed signs of neuroretinitis, while serological testing confirmed recent dengue infection. The case highlights the importance of considering dengue in the differential diagnosis of posterior segment inflammation, even in atypical presentations. The patient was treated with corticosteroids, leading to anatomical improvement and visual recovery. The study's findings are significant for understanding dengue's ocular manifestations and improving diagnostic approaches for returning travelers. However, the study's single-case design limits its generalizability, though the evidence is strong due to comprehensive clinical and diagnostic assessments.

papers.title: RELAÇÃO ENTRE A INCIDÊNCIA DE DENGUE E VULNERABILIDADE SOCIOECONÔMICA NOS MUNICÍPIOS DE ALAGOAS ENTRE 2020 E 2025 RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN DENGUE INCIDENCE AND SOCIOECONOMIC VULNERABILITY IN THE MUNICIPALITIES OF ALAGOAS BETWEEN 2020 AND 2025 RELACIÓN ENTRE LA INCIDENCIA DEL DENGUE Y LA VULNERABILIDAD SOCIOECONÓMICA EN LOS MUNICIPIOS DE ALAGOAS ENTRE 2020 Y 2025
papers.abstract: A dengue é uma doença de grande relevância para a saúde pública, especialmente em países tropicais e subtropicais como o Brasil. Sua ocorrência pode estar relacionada a desigualdades sociais e condições ambientais que influenciam a exposição ao vetor e o acesso aos serviços de saúde. Este estudo analisou a relação entre a incidência de dengue e vulnerabilidade social nos municípios de Alagoas, entre 2020 e 2025. Foi realizado estudo epidemiológico com dados secundários do SINAN/DATASUS, obtidos pela plataforma TabNet, considerando casos prováveis, município de notificação e ano do primeiro sintoma. Também foram utilizados os Índices de Vulnerabilidade Social (IVS) disponibilizados pelo IPEA. Foram analisados 20 municípios, sendo 10 com maior e 10 com menor IVS. Observou-se maior incidência média entre os municípios de menor IVS em todos os anos, com destaque para 2022, quando as médias foram de 1.269,99 e 338,76 casos/100 mil habitantes nos grupos de menor e maior IVS, respectivamente. A correlação de Spearman foi negativa em todos os anos, variando de ρ = -0,204 a ρ = -0,526, com maior magnitude em 2022 (ρ = -0,526; p<0,05). Os resultados sugerem que a vulnerabilidade social, isoladamente, não explica a distribuição da dengue.
authors: Camylle Victória Marques de Araújo Farias
papers.journal: Revista Ibero-Americana de Humanidades, Ciências e Educação

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate the relationship between dengue incidence and socioeconomic vulnerability in the municipalities of Alagoas between 2020 and 2025. Dengue is a significant public health issue, particularly in tropical and subtropical countries like Brazil, where social inequalities and environmental conditions may influence vector exposure and access to healthcare.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was an epidemiological analysis using secondary data from SINAN/DATASUS through the TabNet platform, considering probable cases, notification municipality, and the year of first symptoms. It included 20 municipalities, with 10 having higher and 10 having lower Social Vulnerability Indices (IVS).
analysis.methods: The study employed secondary data from SINAN/DATASUS, obtained via TabNet, and used Social Vulnerability Indices (IVS) provided by IPEA. It analyzed probable dengue cases, their notification municipality, and the year of first symptoms to assess the relationship between socioeconomic vulnerability and dengue incidence.
analysis.main_results: The study observed higher average incidence rates in municipalities with lower IVS across all years, with a notable difference in 2022, where the rates were 1,269.99 and 338.76 cases per 100,000 inhabitants in the lower and higher IVS groups, respectively. The Spearman correlation was negative in all years, ranging from ρ = -0.204 to ρ = -0.526, with the strongest correlation in 2022 (ρ = -0.526; p<0.05).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that socioeconomic vulnerability alone does not fully explain the distribution of dengue cases, highlighting the need for further research into the complex interplay of factors affecting dengue transmission.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results can inform public health strategies by emphasizing the importance of addressing socioeconomic disparities in dengue prevention and control efforts, particularly in regions with varying levels of vulnerability.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on secondary data and the potential for unmeasured confounding factors. The evidence is moderate, as the analysis is based on observational data without direct intervention or experimental validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the relationship between dengue incidence and socioeconomic vulnerability in the municipalities of Alagoas between 2020 and 2025. Using secondary data from SINAN/DATASUS and Social Vulnerability Indices (IVS) from IPEA, it found higher dengue rates in areas with lower socioeconomic vulnerability, particularly in 2022. The negative Spearman correlation across all years suggests a link, though the study notes that vulnerability alone does not fully explain dengue distribution. These findings highlight the need to consider socioeconomic factors in dengue prevention strategies but are limited by observational data and potential confounding variables. The evidence is moderate in strength due to these limitations.

elements_zh.methods: 该研究采用了通过 TabNet 获得的 SINAN/DATASUS 二手数据,并使用了 IPEA 提供的社会脆弱性指数 (IVS)。它分析了可能的登革热病例、其通知城市以及首次出现症状的年份,以评估社会经济脆弱性与登革热 发病率 之间的关系。
elements_zh.main_results: The study observed higher average incidence rates in municipalities with lower IVS across all years, with a notable difference in 2022, where the rates were 1,269.99 and 338.76 cases per 100,000 inhabitants in the lower and higher IVS groups, respectively. papers.title_zh: 2020 年至 2025 年阿拉戈斯登革热事件与社会经济脆弱性之间的关系 登革热 发病率 与阿拉戈斯各市社会经济脆弱性之间的关系2020 年和 2025 年 2020 年和 2025 年阿拉戈斯市的登革热事件和社会经济脆弱性关系
papers.source_body_en: A dengue é uma doença de grande relevância para a saúde pública, especialmente em países tropicais e subtropicais como o Brasil. Sua ocorrência pode estar relacionada a desigualdades sociais e condições ambientais que influenciam a exposição ao vetor e o acesso aos serviços de saúde. Este estudo analisou a relação entre a incidência de dengue e vulnerabilidade social nos municípios de Alagoas, entre 2020 e 2025. Foi realizado estudo epidemiológico com dados secundários do SINAN/DATASUS, obtidos pela plataforma TabNet, considerando casos prováveis, município de notificação e ano do primeiro sintoma. Também foram utilizados os Índices de Vulnerabilidade Social (IVS) disponibilizados pelo IPEA. Foram analisados 20 municípios, sendo 10 com maior e 10 com menor IVS. Observou-se maior incidência média entre os municípios de menor IVS em todos os anos, com destaque para 2022, quando as médias foram de 1.269,99 e 338,76 casos/100 mil habitantes nos grupos de menor e maior IVS, respectivamente. A correlação de Spearman foi negativa em todos os anos, variando de ρ = -0,204 a ρ = -0,526, com maior magnitude em 2022 (ρ = -0,526; p<0,05). Os resultados sugerem que a vulnerabilidade social, isoladamente, não explica a distribuição da dengue.

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是通过 TabNet 平台使用 SIAN/DATASUS 的二手数据进行的流行病学分析,考虑了可能病例、通知城市和首次出现症状的年份。其中包括 20 个城市,其中 10 个城市的社会脆弱性指数 (IVS) 较高,10 个城市的社会脆弱性指数较低。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究采用了通过 TabNet 获得的 SINAN/DATASUS 二手数据,并使用了 IPEA 提供的社会脆弱性指数 (IVS)。它分析了可能的登革热病例、其通知城市以及首次出现症状的年份,以评估社会经济脆弱性与登革热 发病率 之间的关系。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,仅靠社会经济脆弱性并不能完全解释登革热病例的分布,突出表明需要进一步研究影响登革热 传播 因素的复杂相互作用。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以通过强调解决登革热预防和控制工作中社会经济差异的重要性,为公共卫生战略提供信息,特别是在脆弱程度不同的地区。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其对二手数据的依赖以及可能存在未测量的混杂因素而受到限制。证据是中等的,因为分析是基于观察数据而没有直接干预或实验验证。

papers.title: Spatial Association Between Dengue Incidence and Larvae-Free Index: A Bivariate Spatial Autocorrelation Analysis in Surabaya, Indonesia
papers.abstract: Introduction: Dengue transmission in Surabaya, Indonesia, varies across urban villages, but its spatial relationship with vector-control performance remains insufficiently understood. This study examined dengue incidence, the Larvae-Free Index (LFI), and their bivariate spatial association. Methods: This spatial ecological study analysed annual confirmed dengue cases and LFI data from all 154 urban villages in Surabaya during 2020–2025, obtained from the Surabaya City Health Office. Incidence was calculated per 10,000 population. Multiplicative seasonal decomposition characterised monthly case patterns. Global Moran’s I and Local Indicators of Spatial Association (LISA) assessed spatial clustering, while Bivariate Moran’s I and Bivariate LISA (BiLISA) examined associations between local dengue incidence and neighbouring LFI values. Results and Discussion: Dengue incidence clustered significantly in five of six years (I = 0.0784–0.2727), except 2024 (I = 0.0280; p = 0.222). LFI clustered significantly every year (I = 0.2190–0.3087; p = 0.001). Bivariate Moran’s I was negative in five years and significant in 2020 (−0.0805; p = 0.022), 2021 (−0.0875; p = 0.019), and 2025 (−0.1046; p = 0.003), indicating spatial associations between higher incidence and lower neighbouring LFI. In 2025, LISA identified 10 High–High and 15 Low–Low dengue clusters. BiLISA identified High–Low villages annually, with Ujung and Pegirian recurring most frequently. Conclusion: Dengue incidence and LFI exhibited spatial clustering, with significant inverse spatial associations in three years. LFI should complement, rather than replace, dengue surveillance when identifying priority areas for targeted vector control.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to examine the spatial relationship between dengue incidence and the Larvae-Free Index (LFI) in Surabaya, Indonesia, as dengue transmission varies across urban villages and the spatial association with vector-control performance remains insufficiently understood.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A spatial ecological study was conducted in all 154 urban villages of Surabaya, Indonesia, during the years 2020–2025, using annual confirmed dengue cases and LFI data obtained from the Surabaya City Health Office.
analysis.methods: Dengue incidence was calculated per 10,000 population, and monthly case patterns were characterised using multiplicative seasonal decomposition. Spatial clustering was assessed using Global Moran’s I and Local Indicators of Spatial Association (LISA), while Bivariate Moran’s I and Bivariate LISA (BiLISA) examined associations between local dengue incidence and neighbouring LFI values.
analysis.main_results: Global Moran’s I indicated significant dengue incidence clustering in five of six years (I = 0.0784–0.2727), except 2024 (I = 0.0280; p = 0.222). LFI clustered significantly every year (I = 0.2190–0.3087; p = 0.001). Bivariate Moran’s I was negative in five years and significant in 2020, 2021, and 2025, showing inverse spatial associations between higher dengue incidence and lower neighbouring LFI.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study found significant inverse spatial associations between dengue incidence and LFI in three years, suggesting that areas with lower LFI values may be associated with higher dengue incidence, which is a novel finding in understanding spatial dynamics of dengue transmission.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings can inform targeted vector control strategies by highlighting areas where lower LFI values correlate with higher dengue incidence, thus aiding in the prioritisation of surveillance and intervention efforts.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to spatial ecological analysis and does not account for other factors influencing dengue transmission. The evidence is moderate as it relies on aggregated data and spatial statistical methods without individual-level analysis.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the spatial association between dengue incidence and the Larvae-Free Index (LFI) in Surabaya, Indonesia, from 2020 to 2025. Using spatial ecological methods, it found significant clustering of dengue cases and LFI values across years, with inverse associations between higher incidence and lower LFI in three years. These results suggest that LFI could be a useful supplementary indicator for identifying priority areas for vector control. The study's findings have implications for improving surveillance and targeted interventions but are limited by the use of aggregated data and lack of individual-level analysis, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在研究印度尼西亚泗水登革热 发病率 与无幼虫指数 (LFI) 之间的空间关系,因为登革热 传播 因城中村而异,且与 媒介 控制绩效的空间关联仍不清楚。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2020年至2025年间,利用每年确诊的登革热病例和从泗水市卫生办公室获得的LFI数据,对印度尼西亚泗水的所有154个城中村进行了空间生态研究。
elements_zh.methods: 登革热 发病率 按每 10,000 人计算,并使用乘法季节性分解来表征每月病例模式。使用全局 Moran’s I 和局部空间关联指标 (LISA) 评估空间聚类,而双变量 Moran’s I 和双变量 LISA (BiLISA) 检查局部登革热 发病率 与邻近 LFI 值之间的关联。
elements_zh.main_results: Global Moran's I 表明登革热 发病率 在六年中的五年内出现显着聚集(I = 0.0784–0.2727),2024 年除外(I = 0.0280;p = 0.222)。LFI 每年都会显着聚集(I = 0.2190–0.3087;p = 0.001)。双变量 Moran’s I 在五年内为负值,在 2020 年、2021 年和 2025 年显着,显示较高的登革热 发病率 和较低的邻近 LFI 之间存在逆空间关联。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究发现三年内登革热发病率与LFI之间存在显着的逆空间关联,这表明LFI值较低的区域可能与登革热发病率较高相关,这是理解登革热传播空间动态的一个新发现。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以通过突出显示较低 LFI 值与较高登革热 监测 相关的区域,为有针对性的 媒介 控制策略提供信息,从而有助于确定 监测 和干预工作的优先顺序。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to examine the spatial relationship between dengue incidence and the Larvae-Free Index (LFI) in Surabaya, Indonesia, as dengue transmission varies across urban villages and the spatial association with vector-control performance remains insufficiently understood.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A spatial ecological study was conducted in all 154 urban villages of Surabaya, Indonesia, during the years 2020–2025, using annual confirmed dengue cases and LFI data obtained from the Surabaya City Health Office.
analysis_en.methods: Dengue incidence was calculated per 10,000 population, and monthly case patterns were characterised using multiplicative seasonal decomposition. Spatial clustering was assessed using Global Moran’s I and Local Indicators of Spatial Association (LISA), while Bivariate Moran’s I and Bivariate LISA (BiLISA) examined associations between local dengue incidence and neighbouring LFI values.
analysis_en.main_results: Global Moran’s I indicated significant dengue incidence clustering in five of six years (I = 0.0784–0.2727), except 2024 (I = 0.0280; p = 0.222). LFI clustered significantly every year (I = 0.2190–0.3087; p = 0.001). Bivariate Moran’s I was negative in five years and significant in 2020, 2021, and 2025, showing inverse spatial associations between higher dengue incidence and lower neighbouring LFI.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study found significant inverse spatial associations between dengue incidence and LFI in three years, suggesting that areas with lower LFI values may be associated with higher dengue incidence, which is a novel finding in understanding spatial dynamics of dengue transmission.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings can inform targeted vector control strategies by highlighting areas where lower LFI values correlate with higher dengue incidence, thus aiding in the prioritisation of surveillance and intervention efforts.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to spatial ecological analysis and does not account for other factors influencing dengue transmission. The evidence is moderate as it relies on aggregated data and spatial statistical methods without individual-level analysis.

papers.title_zh: 登革热 发病率 与无幼虫指数之间的空间关联:印度尼西亚泗水的双变量空间自相关分析
papers.source_body_en: Introduction: Dengue transmission in Surabaya, Indonesia, varies across urban villages, but its spatial relationship with vector-control performance remains insufficiently understood. This study examined dengue incidence, the Larvae-Free Index (LFI), and their bivariate spatial association. Methods: This spatial ecological study analysed annual confirmed dengue cases and LFI data from all 154 urban villages in Surabaya during 2020–2025, obtained from the Surabaya City Health Office. Incidence was calculated per 10,000 population. Multiplicative seasonal decomposition characterised monthly case patterns. Global Moran’s I and Local Indicators of Spatial Association (LISA) assessed spatial clustering, while Bivariate Moran’s I and Bivariate LISA (BiLISA) examined associations between local dengue incidence and neighbouring LFI values. Results and Discussion: Dengue incidence clustered significantly in five of six years (I = 0.0784–0.2727), except 2024 (I = 0.0280; p = 0.222). LFI clustered significantly every year (I = 0.2190–0.3087; p = 0.001). Bivariate Moran’s I was negative in five years and significant in 2020 (−0.0805; p = 0.022), 2021 (−0.0875; p = 0.019), and 2025 (−0.1046; p = 0.003), indicating spatial associations between higher incidence and lower neighbouring LFI. In 2025, LISA identified 10 High–High and 15 Low–Low dengue clusters. BiLISA identified High–Low villages annually, with Ujung and Pegirian recurring most frequently. Conclusion: Dengue incidence and LFI exhibited spatial clustering, with significant inverse spatial associations in three years. LFI should complement, rather than replace, dengue surveillance when identifying priority areas for targeted vector control.
papers.abstract_zh: 简介:印度尼西亚泗水的登革热 传播 因城中村而异,但其与 媒介 控制绩效的空间关系仍不清楚。本研究检查了登革热 发病率、无幼虫指数 (LFI) 及其双变量空间关联。方法:这项空间生态研究分析了从泗水市卫生办公室获得的 2020-2025 年泗水所有 154 个城中村的年度确诊登革热病例和 LFI 数据。发病率 按每 10,000 人计算。乘法季节性分解表征了每月病例模式。全球 Moran’s I 和局部空间关联指标 (LISA) 评估空间聚类,而双变量 Moran’s I 和双变量 LISA (BiLISA) 检查局部登革热 发病率 与邻近 LFI 值之间的关联。结果和讨论:登革热 发病率 在六年中的五年内显着聚集(I = 0.0784–0.2727),2024 年除外(I = 0.0280;p = 0.222)。LFI 每年都会显着聚集(I = 0.2190–0.3087;p = 0.001)。双变量 Moran’s I 在五年内为负值,并在 2020 年(−0.0805;p = 0.022)、2021 年(−0.0875;p = 0.019)和 2025 年(−0.1046;p = 0.003)显着,表明较高的 发病率 和较低的邻近 LFI 之间存在空间关联。2025 年,LISA 确定了 10 个高-高和 15 个低-低登革热集群。BiLISA 每年都会确定高低村庄,其中 Ujung 和 Pegirian 出现频率最高。结论:登革热发病率和LFI表现出空间聚集性,三年内具有显着的空间逆相关性。在确定目标 媒介 控制的优先领域时,LFI 应补充而不是取代登革热 监测。

papers.title: The Relationship Between Environmental Sanitation and the Incidence of Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DHF) at Pengaringan Community Health Center, Pagar Alam City, in 2025
papers.abstract: The incidence of dengue fever has increased dramatically worldwide. The incidence of dengue fever is caused by environmental sanitation factors. In 2025 there will be an increase in dengue cases to 38 cases as of February 2025 based on data from the Pagaralam City Health Office, this significant increase makes researchers want to analyze the causes of dengue in terms of environmental sanitation. The purpose of this study is to determine the relationship between environmental sanitation and the incidence of dengue hemorrhagic fever (DHF) at the Pagaralam City Drainage Health Center in 2025. The research method used Cross Sectional with a sample of 162 respondents taken by accidental sampling. The results showed that the variables related to the incidence of dengue from environmental sanitation were the environmental condition of the house p value 0.004, water reservoir p value 0.013, and livestock cage sanitation p value 0.000. There was no relationship between SPAL and the waste disposal system with the incidence of dengue. It can be concluded that environmental sanitation is related to the incidence of dengue with the most dominant factor being the sanitation of livestock cages. It is recommended for the Pagaralam City Health Office to be able to create a program related to "Every Child is Jumantik", this program can be carried out by the Health Office in collaboration with schools and the surrounding community. Schools can assign each child to be a jumantik in their respective homes.

elements_zh.main_results: 结果表明,房屋环境条件(p = 0.004)、水储存宿主(p = 0.013)和牲畜笼子卫生(p = 0.000)与登革热发病率显着相关。然而,没有发现SPAL与登革热发病率的废物处理系统之间存在任何关系。

analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional study was conducted in 2025 at Pengaringan Community Health Center, Pagar Alam City, involving 162 respondents selected through accidental sampling. analysis_en.methods: The study employed a cross-sectional design with accidental sampling to collect data from 162 respondents. Schools can assign each child to be a jumantik in their respective homes.

papers.title: Association Between Nonstructural Protein 1 Antigenemia and Leukopenia in Dengue Infection
papers.abstract: Background: Dengue is a widespread mosquito-borne illness across tropical and subtropical areas. Leukopenia is a common hematological abnormality in dengue infection; however, the association between dengue serological markers and white blood cell (WBC) count has not been well characterized. Objective: To evaluate the association between dengue nonstructural protein 1 (NS1) antigen positivity, dengue immunoglobulin M (IgM) antibody positivity, and WBC count categories among serologically confirmed dengue patients. Materials and Methods: A retrospective observational study was conducted among 457 serologically confirmed dengue patients attending a tertiary care teaching hospital between October and December 2025. Demographic characteristics, dengue NS1 antigen status, dengue IgM antibody status, and WBC counts were obtained from laboratory records. WBC counts were categorized as leukopenia ( 11,000 cells/mm 3 ). Associations between serological markers and WBC count categories were analyzed using Pearson’s chi-square test. Odds ratios (ORs) with 95% CIs were calculated where appropriate. Results: Among the 457 patients, leukopenia was observed in 145 (31.7%), while 305 (66.7%) had normal counts and 7 (1.5%) had leukocytosis. NS1 antigen was positive in 288 patients (63.0%) and dengue IgM antibody in 264 (57.8%). Leukopenia was present in 128 of 288 NS1 antigen-positive patients (44.4%) compared with 17 of 169 NS1 antigen-negative patients (10.1%) (Fisher exact test, P < 0.001; OR: 7.15; 95% CI: 4.12-12.43). As a marker of NS1 antigen positivity, leukopenia showed a specificity of 89.9% (95% CI: 84.5-93.6) and a positive predictive value of 88.3% (95% CI: 82.0-92.5), but a sensitivity of only 44.4% (95% CI: 38.8-50.2). Dengue IgM antibody positivity showed the opposite relationship: leukopenia was present in 63 of 264 IgM-positive patients (23.9%) compared with 69 of 177 IgM-negative patients (39.0%) (Fisher exact test, P < 0.001; OR: 0.49; 95% CI: 0.32-0.74). Leukopenia was most frequent in the small group with equivocal IgM results (13/16, 81.2%). Conclusions: Leukopenia was markedly more frequent among NS1 antigen-positive patients and markedly less frequent among IgM antibody-positive patients, indicating that leukopenia clusters in the early viremic phase of dengue infection and resolves as the antibody response develops. Leukopenia was specific but insensitive as a marker of the NS1 antigen-positive phase, so its principal practical value may lie in informing the choice and timing of serological testing rather than in confirming a diagnosis already established by NS1 antigen detection. Prospective multicenter studies recording the day of illness at presentation, serial hematological measurements, quantitative NS1 antigen levels, and clinical outcomes are warranted to validate these findings.

papers.title_zh: 登革热感染中非结构蛋白 1 抗原血症与白细胞减少症之间的关联
papers.source_body_en: Background: Dengue is a widespread mosquito-borne illness across tropical and subtropical areas. Leukopenia is a common hematological abnormality in dengue infection; however, the association between dengue serological markers and white blood cell (WBC) count has not been well characterized. Objective: To evaluate the association between dengue nonstructural protein 1 (NS1) antigen positivity, dengue immunoglobulin M (IgM) antibody positivity, and WBC count categories among serologically confirmed dengue patients. Materials and Methods: A retrospective observational study was conducted among 457 serologically confirmed dengue patients attending a tertiary care teaching hospital between October and December 2025. Demographic characteristics, dengue NS1 antigen status, dengue IgM antibody status, and WBC counts were obtained from laboratory records. WBC counts were categorized as leukopenia ( 11,000 cells/mm 3 ). Associations between serological markers and WBC count categories were analyzed using Pearson’s chi-square test. Odds ratios (ORs) with 95% CIs were calculated where appropriate. Results: Among the 457 patients, leukopenia was observed in 145 (31.7%), while 305 (66.7%) had normal counts and 7 (1.5%) had leukocytosis. NS1 antigen was positive in 288 patients (63.0%) and dengue IgM antibody in 264 (57.8%). Leukopenia was present in 128 of 288 NS1 antigen-positive patients (44.4%) compared with 17 of 169 NS1 antigen-negative patients (10.1%) (Fisher exact test, P < 0.001; OR: 7.15; 95% CI: 4.12-12.43). As a marker of NS1 antigen positivity, leukopenia showed a specificity of 89.9% (95% CI: 84.5-93.6) and a positive predictive value of 88.3% (95% CI: 82.0-92.5), but a sensitivity of only 44.4% (95% CI: 38.8-50.2). Dengue IgM antibody positivity showed the opposite relationship: leukopenia was present in 63 of 264 IgM-positive patients (23.9%) compared with 69 of 177 IgM-negative patients (39.0%) (Fisher exact test, P < 0.001; OR: 0.49; 95% CI: 0.32-0.74). Leukopenia was most frequent in the small group with equivocal IgM results (13/16, 81.2%). Conclusions: Leukopenia was markedly more frequent among NS1 antigen-positive patients and markedly less frequent among IgM antibody-positive patients, indicating that leukopenia clusters in the early viremic phase of dengue infection and resolves as the antibody response develops. Leukopenia was specific but insensitive as a marker of the NS1 antigen-positive phase, so its principal practical value may lie in informing the choice and timing of serological testing rather than in confirming a diagnosis already established by NS1 antigen detection. Prospective multicenter studies recording the day of illness at presentation, serial hematological measurements, quantitative NS1 antigen levels, and clinical outcomes are warranted to validate these findings.

papers.title: Estrategias de prevención del dengue en comunidades urbanas: revisión sistemática Dengue prevention strategies in urban communities: a systematic review
papers.abstract: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre la efectividad de las estrategias de prevención del dengue en comunidades urbanas y su aplicabilidad al contexto ecuatoriano. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: revisiones sistemáticas con y sin metaanálisis, estudios en Ecuador, intervenciones comunitarias y una evaluación económica. Resultados: el control químico aislado redujo los índices entomológicos sin efecto demostrado sobre la transmisión. El manejo ambiental con participación comunitaria, las mallas en las viviendas y las cubiertas de recipientes mostraron los resultados más favorables. El almacenamiento de agua, la percepción del riesgo y la falta de servicios básicos condicionaron la prevención en Ecuador. Conclusión: la prevención del dengue urbano requiere estrategias integradas, comunitarias y sostenidas, con vigilancia epidemiológica y mejoras de los servicios básicos.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review aims to synthesize evidence on the effectiveness of dengue prevention strategies in urban communities and assess their applicability to the Ecuadorian context.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: A systematic review was conducted using PubMed and SciELO databases from 2012 to 2025. The evidence includes 15 studies: systematic reviews with and without meta-analyses, studies conducted in Ecuador, community interventions, and an economic evaluation.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review found that integrated, community-based, and sustained strategies, including environmental management, window screens, and covered water containers, showed the most favorable results in dengue prevention. However, chemical control alone reduced entomological indices without demonstrated impact on transmission.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights that factors such as water storage practices, risk perception, and lack of basic services influenced prevention effectiveness in Ecuador. There is no explicit mention of conflicting findings or heterogeneity in the results.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review concludes that dengue prevention in urban areas requires integrated, community-based, and sustained strategies, along with epidemiological surveillance and improvements in basic services.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review evaluates dengue prevention strategies in urban communities, focusing on their effectiveness and applicability in Ecuador. The evidence base includes 15 studies from PubMed and SciELO, spanning 2012 to 2025, encompassing systematic reviews, community interventions, and economic evaluations. Key findings indicate that integrated, community-based, and sustained strategies, such as environmental management, window screens, and covered water containers, yielded the most favorable outcomes. However, chemical control alone reduced entomological indices without clear evidence of impact on transmission. The review emphasizes the need for strategies that incorporate epidemiological surveillance and improvements in basic services to effectively prevent dengue in urban settings. The study also notes that factors like water storage practices, risk perception, and lack of basic services influenced prevention success in Ecuador. The implications suggest a focus on community engagement and long-term, sustainable interventions to address dengue in urban populations.

elements_en.scope_and_question: The review aims to synthesize evidence on the effectiveness of dengue prevention strategies in urban communities and assess their applicability to the Ecuadorian context.
elements_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: A systematic review was conducted using PubMed and SciELO databases from 2012 to 2025. The evidence includes 15 studies: systematic reviews with and without meta-analyses, studies conducted in Ecuador, community interventions, and an economic evaluation.
elements_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review found that integrated, community-based, and sustained strategies, including environmental management, window screens, and covered water containers, showed the most favorable results in dengue prevention. However, chemical control alone reduced entomological indices without demonstrated impact on transmission.
elements_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights that factors such as water storage practices, risk perception, and lack of basic services influenced prevention effectiveness in Ecuador. There is no explicit mention of conflicting findings or heterogeneity in the results.
elements_en.research_and_practice_implications: The review concludes that dengue prevention in urban areas requires integrated, community-based, and sustained strategies, along with epidemiological surveillance and improvements in basic services.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该审查旨在综合城市社区登革热预防策略有效性的证据,并评估其在厄瓜多尔国情中的适用性。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 使用 PubMed 和 SciELO 数据库从 2012 年至 2025 年进行了系统评价。证据包括 15 项研究:有或没有荟萃分析的系统评价、在厄瓜多尔进行的研究、社区干预措施和经济评估。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 审查发现,综合、基于社区和持续的策略,包括环境管理、纱窗和有盖水容器,在预防登革热方面显示出最有利的结果。然而,单独的化学控制降低了昆虫学指数,但没有显示出对 传播 的影响。

papers.title_zh: Estrategias de prevención del dengue en comunidades Urbanas:revisión sistemática 城市社区登革热预防策略:系统回顾
papers.source_body_en: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre la efectividad de las estrategias de prevención del dengue en comunidades urbanas y su aplicabilidad al contexto ecuatoriano. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: revisiones sistemáticas con y sin metaanálisis, estudios en Ecuador, intervenciones comunitarias y una evaluación económica. Resultados: el control químico aislado redujo los índices entomológicos sin efecto demostrado sobre la transmisión. El manejo ambiental con participación comunitaria, las mallas en las viviendas y las cubiertas de recipientes mostraron los resultados más favorables. El almacenamiento de agua, la percepción del riesgo y la falta de servicios básicos condicionaron la prevención en Ecuador. Conclusión: la prevención del dengue urbano requiere estrategias integradas, comunitarias y sostenidas, con vigilancia epidemiológica y mejoras de los servicios básicos.
papers.abstract_zh: 目的:证明在城市社区和厄瓜多尔环境中预防登革热的有效策略。方法:PubMed 和 SciELO 中的 síntesis narrativa 的修订(2012-2025);其中包括 15 个研究室:对系统的修订和元分析、厄瓜多尔的研究室、社区干预和经济评估。结果:控制力降低了昆虫学指标,从而影响了传播。El manejo 环境与社区参与、生活和受惠者的立方体最有利的结果。厄瓜多尔的水、水的感知和基本预防服务的故障。结论:城市登革热的预防需要综合、社区和支持、流行病学和基本服务的良好策略。

papers.title: Intelligent drone-based biosensor for the detection of dengue virus antigen towards smart unmanned aerial-vehicle platform-based virus diagnosis
papers.abstract: In the current work, we established a smart system for dengue diagnosis that enables on-site detection while removing the need for human intervention and continuous monitoring in difficult-to-reach areas. The system comprises of 4-smart technologies: i) drone, ii) biosensor, iii) Yolov5 AI-module, iv) a QR-code-derived digital website linked patient E-Prescription barcode, where the biosensor acts as a smart detector, and the drone as a vehicle for transporting the biosensor to the testing zone. Deep learning analysis was done by an expert using an artificial intelligence module; additional QR-code-based websites were added to the system, allowing users to scan the code and send detection data to laboratory authorities, and the patient got a medical e-prescription from the doctor. The proposed system has lightweight materials, optimized power sources, and weather-resistant housing to ensure reliable on-site diagnostics. However, practical challenges associated with drone-based diagnostic deployment, including environmental conditions, flight stability, battery capacity, payload constraints, and reliable operation in remote settings, should be considered when evaluating the field applicability and scalability of the proposed system. The suggested detection platform used the instrument-less lateral flow colorimetric approach, enabling naked-eye detection of dengue virus antigen with an LOD of 0.91 μg/mL within 5 s. As a consequence, the Drone-based approach allows clinicians to monitor the dengue virus antigen in remote populations. Accordingly, governments and non-profit organizations can utilize this technology to monitor the red alert zone, receiving precise and reliable data for informed decision-making.

papers.title: SÍNDROME DE WATERHOUSE-FRIDERICHSEN POR MENINGOCOCCEMIA E COINFECÇÃO COM DENGUE: RELATO DE CASO
papers.abstract: Introdução: A Síndrome de Waterhouse-Friderichsen (SWF) é uma doença rara caracterizada por insuficiência adrenal, geralmente relacionada à meningococcemia, embora existam outras causas. A ocorrência concomitante de dengue e SWF é extremamente incomum, o que representa um desafio tanto no diagnóstico quanto no tratamento. Objetivo: Relatar um caso de Síndrome de Waterhouse-Friderichsen associada à coinfecção por Neisseria meningitidis e vírus da dengue enfatizando os resultados clínicos, laboratoriais e anatomopatológicos. Metodologia: Foram analisados dados clínicos, laboratoriais, macroscópicos e histopatológicos obtidos de prontuário médico e exame necroscópico realizado pelo Serviço de Verificação de Óbitos de Barbalha (CE). O diagnóstico foi baseado na pesquisa de agentes infecciosos por meio de exames laboratoriais relacionados aos resultados macroscópicos e microscópicos e à fisiopatologia da SWF. Resultados: Paciente masculino, 26 anos, apresentou febre, dor abdominal, púrpura difusa e choque séptico, evoluindo para óbito. O exame post-mortem revelou a presença de Neisseria meningitidis e vírus DENV-1. Esses achados confirmaram coinfecção por meningococo e dengue com quadro de coagulação intravascular disseminada e falência das glândulas adrenais. Conclusão: A associação entre dengue e SWF é rara, porém de alta gravidade. O diagnóstico precoce e a intervenção imediata são vitais; além disso, a autópsia é importante para entender o caso.

Objetivo: Relatar um caso de Síndrome de Waterhouse-Friderichsen associada à coinfecção por Neisseria meningitidis e vírus da dengue enfatizando os resultados clínicos, laboratoriais e anatomopatológicos. Metodologia: Foram analisados dados clínicos, laboratoriais, macroscópicos e histopatológicos obtidos de prontuário médico e exame necroscópico realizado pelo Serviço de Verificação de Óbitos de Barbalha (CE). O diagnóstico foi baseado na pesquisa de agentes infecciosos por meio de exames laboratoriais relacionados aos resultados macroscópicos e microscópicos e à fisiopatologia da SWF. Resultados: Paciente masculino, 26 anos, apresentou febre, dor abdominal, púrpura difusa e choque séptico, evoluindo para óbito. O exame post-mortem revelou a presença de Neisseria meningitidis e vírus DENV-1. Esses achados confirmaram coinfecção por meningococo e dengue com quadro de coagulação intravascular disseminada e falência das glândulas adrenais. Conclusão: A associação entre dengue e SWF é rara, porém de alta gravidade. O diagnóstico precoce e a intervenção imediata são vitais; além disso, a autópsia é importante para entender o caso.

analysis.summary_en: This study reports a rare case of Waterhouse-Friderichsen syndrome (SWF) associated with co-infection by Neisseria meningitidis and Dengue virus 1. The patient, a 26-year-old male, presented with fever, abdominal pain, diffuse purpura, and septic shock, ultimately leading to death. Post-mortem examination confirmed the presence of both pathogens, highlighting the coagulation disorder and adrenal failure. The authors emphasize the importance of early diagnosis and autopsy in understanding such complex co-infections. The case underscores the rarity and severity of the association between dengue and SWF, contributing to clinical awareness and surveillance efforts. However, the study is limited to a single case, which may affect the generalizability of the findings.

papers.title: Gold-Enhanced Multielectrode Electrochemical Immunosensor for Rapid Electrochemical Detection of Dengue NS1
papers.abstract: Abstract Dengue is one of the most widespread viral diseases in the world, transmitted mainly by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus. In tropical and resource-limited regions, rapid and accurate diagnostic tools are of utmost importance, especially when aiming for effective control, but current detection methods face limitations in sensitivity, specificity, or accessibility. In this work, a multielectrode disposable electrochemical immunosensor was developed for the detection of the nonstructural protein 1 (NS1), an early biomarker of dengue infection. This device presents four fully individual and functional working electrodes modified with gold nanoparticles. This configuration enables replicate measurements and improved reproducibility within a single platform while using minimal sample volume. The electrodeposition of Au nanoparticles was optimized through Design of Experiments approaches, allowing the system to suitably determine the target protein with a specific biorecognition architecture based on antibody–antigen recognition. This biosensor was characterized by morphological and electrochemical techniques, achieving a linear response between 1.0 and 200 ng mL–1 and a limit of detection of 0.34 ng mL–1. Afterward, human serum samples spiked with NS1 showed recovery rates between 96.6% and 115%. All results indicate that the proposed multielectrode immunosensor is a promising, label-free, and portable diagnostic alternative for NS1 determination while maintaining a relatively low cost and simple preparation.

papers.title: A pilot study on the impact of infection routes on disease progression and immune response by dengue infection in AG129 mice
papers.abstract: AG129 mouse is a mouse model commonly utilised in the study of dengue pathogenesis using various viral inoculation routes. Different viral infection routes may elicit distinct host responses. This pilot study compares the development of dengue virus infection in AG129 mice via intraperitoneal and subcutaneous routes. AG129 mice were infected with dengue virus type 2 (DENV-2) via intraperitoneal or subcutaneous injection. Disease progression was monitored through daily body weight and morbidity scores for 14 days. Plasma viral RNA levels were quantified by reverse transcription-quantitative PCR. Plasma non-structural protein 1 (NS1) level was determined by dengue NS1 antigen- ELISA method. Platelet and blood differential counts were counted. Plasma cytokines were assessed on day 1, 3, 5, and 7 post-infection using multiplex immunoassay. Body weight loss was similar between groups until day 4 post-infection, where intraperitoneally infected mice showed greater loss. Morbidity signs were more pronounced in intraperitoneally infected mice from day 2 to 6 post-infection. Viremia levels detected by NS1 protein and viral RNA were similar between both routes. Intraperitoneal infection triggered an earlier increase in white blood cells and neutrophil counts, as well as earlier lymphocyte reduction and thrombocytopenia. Cytokine analysis revealed early elevations of seven cytokines in intraperitoneally infected mice. In contrast, subcutaneously infected mice showed higher levels of interferon-γ and interleukin-10. Intraperitoneal infection in AG129 mice with DENV-2 induced thrombocytopenia, earlier immune responses and transiently higher morbidity as compared to the subcutaneous route. Therefore, different routes of virus inoculation should be carefully considered in future experimental designs using the AG129 mouse model.

The study compared intraperitoneal and subcutaneous routes, finding that intraperitoneal infection led to greater body weight loss and more pronounced morbidity signs from day 2 to 6 post-infection. The findings suggest that infection route significantly influences disease progression and immune response, emphasizing the need to consider these factors in future experimental designs. However, the study's limited sample size and reliance on abstract-only data mean the evidence is moderate in strength.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在调查不同的感染途径如何影响 登革病毒 感染中的疾病进展和 免疫应答,因为不同的病毒接种途径可能会引发不同的 宿主 反应。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对通过腹膜内或皮下途径感染 登革病毒 2 型 (DENV-2) 的 AG129 小鼠进行了初步研究,以比较 登革病毒 感染的发展情况。
elements_zh.methods: 通过逆转录定量PCR对血浆病毒RNA水平进行定量,并通过登革热NS1抗原ELISA方法测定血浆非结构蛋白1(NS1)水平。使用多重免疫测定在感染后第 1、3、5 和 7 天评估血浆细胞因子。
elements_zh.main_results: 直到感染后第 4 天,各组之间的体重下降相似,其中腹膜内感染的小鼠表现出更大的下降。感染后第 2 天至第 6 天,腹腔内感染的小鼠的发病迹象更为明显。细胞因子分析显示,腹腔内感染的小鼠中七种细胞因子的早期升高,而皮下感染的小鼠则显示出较高水平的干扰素-γ和白细胞介素-10。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,与皮下途径相比,AG129小鼠腹腔内感染DENV-2会引起血小板减少症、更早的免疫应答和短暂较高的发病率,这凸显了感染途径在疾病进展中的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可以为未来使用 AG129 小鼠模型的实验设计提供信息,以更好地理解 登革病毒 发病机制 并有可能改进疾病预防和 治疗 的策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是一项试点研究,样本量有限,证据仅基于摘要数据,可能无法完全反映 免疫应答 和疾病进展的复杂性。这些发现的可信度是中等的。
